      change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. change (N.to_nat 32) with 32%nat.
      change (N.to_nat 16) with 16%nat. change (N.to_nat 17) with 17%nat.
      rewrite Nat.pow_add_r. change (2 ^ 9) with 512%nat.
      assert (2 <= (o0 + 16) * 2 ^ k) by nia.
      rewrite Ho16 in Hb. nia.
Qed.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* 17. Value forms (proof.md 6.2): digits of V with heads at positions   *)
(*     0..3 and the marker P at position L.                              *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint vfl (hs : list (list unt)) (L V : nat) : list unt :=
  match L with
  | O => uP :: bin V
  | S L' => hd [] hs ++ dig V :: vfl (tl hs) L' (V / 2)
  end.

Fixpoint vlow (hs : list (list unt)) (L R V : nat) : list unt :=
  match L with
  | O => uP :: digits R V
  | S L' =>
      match R with
      | O => []
      | S R' => hd [] hs ++ dig V :: vlow (tl hs) L' R' (V / 2)
      end
  end.

Lemma digits_mod R V s : digits R (V + 2 ^ R * s) = digits R V.
Proof.
  revert V; induction R as [|R IH]; intros V; [reflexivity|].
  cbn [digits]. rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'.
  replace (V + 2 * 2 ^ R * s) with (V + 2 * (2 ^ R * s)) by lia.
  rewrite dig_add_even, div2_add_even, IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma digits_bin_split R V : 2 ^ R <= V -> bin V = digits R V ++ bin (V / 2 ^ R).
Proof.
  intros H. pose proof (Nat.pow_nonzero 2 R ltac:(lia)) as Hp.
  pose proof (Nat.div_mod_eq V (2 ^ R)) as Ed.
  assert (E : digits R V = digits R (V mod 2 ^ R)).
  { rewrite <- (digits_mod R (V mod 2 ^ R) (V / 2 ^ R)). f_equal. lia. }
  rewrite E, digits_app_bin.
  - f_equal. lia.
  - apply Nat.mod_upper_bound. lia.
  - apply Nat.div_str_pos. lia.
Qed.

Lemma vfl_split hs L R V : L < R -> 2 ^ R <= V -> vfl hs L V = vlow hs L R V ++ bin (V / 2 ^ R).
Proof.
  revert hs R V; induction L as [|L IH]; intros hs R V HL HV.
  - cbn [vfl vlow app]. f_equal. apply digits_bin_split. exact HV.
  - destruct R as [|R]; [lia|]. cbn [vfl vlow]. rewrite <- app_assoc. cbn [app]. f_equal. f_equal.
    rewrite (IH (tl hs) R (V / 2)) by (try lia; rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r' in HV; apply Nat.div_le_lower_bound; lia).
    f_equal. f_equal. rewrite Nat.Div0.div_div. rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma vlow_mod hs L R V s : vlow hs L R (V + 2 ^ R * s) = vlow hs L R V.
Proof.
  revert hs R V; induction L as [|L IH]; intros hs R V.
  - cbn [vlow]. rewrite digits_mod. reflexivity.
  - destruct R as [|R]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [vlow]. rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'.
    replace (V + 2 * 2 ^ R * s) with (V + 2 * (2 ^ R * s)) by lia.
    rewrite dig_add_even, div2_add_even, IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* rows: heads at positions 0..3, lambda, mu, the w slope alpha, w = alpha off + wp - wn, D = j - d *)
Record vrow := mkV { vh : list (list unt); vlam : nat; vmu : nat; val_ : nat; vwp : nat; vwn : nat; vd : nat }.

Definition phrows : list vrow :=
  [ mkV [[uS1]] 24 1 1 0 20 2;
    mkV [[uS1]] 24 1 1 0 20 2;
    mkV [[]; [uS1]] 24 1 1 0 20 2;
    mkV [[]; [uSP]] 25 2 2 0 42 3;
    mkV [[uS1; uP; uP]] 24 1 1 0 24 4;
    mkV [[]; []; [uS1]] 24 1 1 0 21 2;
    mkV [[]; [uS1; uP]] 24 1 1 0 24 3;
    mkV [[uS1; uP; uP]] 24 1 1 0 24 4 ].

Definition phrow (phi : nat) : vrow := nth phi phrows (mkV [] 24 1 1 0 24 4).

Definition vfz (r : vrow) (k Om off : nat) : st :=
  let L := k + vlam r - off in
  let V := vmu r * Om + val_ r * off + vwp r - (vwn r + 3 * 2 ^ (L - 1)) in
  let j := Om + off - 64 in
  (vfl (vh r) L V, j - vd r, j).

Definition off_end (k : nat) : nat := if Nat.eqb ((k + 20) mod 8) 3 then k + 21 else k + 20.

Definition VFe (k Om : nat) : st := vfz (phrow (off_end k mod 8)) k Om (off_end k).

(* the same in N, for the family bases *)
Fixpoint digitsN (r : nat) (v : N) : list unt :=
  match r with O => [] | S r' => digN v :: digitsN r' (N.div2 v) end.

Lemma digitsN_spec r v : digitsN r v = digits r (N.to_nat v).
Proof.
  revert v; induction r as [|r IH]; intros v; [reflexivity|]. cbn [digitsN digits].
  rewrite IH, digN_dig, N2Nat.inj_div2, Nat.div2_div. reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint vlowN (hs : list (list unt)) (L R : nat) (V : N) : list unt :=
  match L with
  | O => uP :: digitsN R V
  | S L' =>
      match R with
      | O => []
      | S R' => hd [] hs ++ digN V :: vlowN (tl hs) L' R' (N.div2 V)
      end
  end.

Lemma vlowN_spec hs L R V : vlowN hs L R V = vlow hs L R (N.to_nat V).
Proof.
  revert hs R V; induction L as [|L IH]; intros hs R V; cbn [vlowN vlow].
  - rewrite digitsN_spec. reflexivity.
  - destruct R; [reflexivity|]. rewrite IH, digN_dig, N2Nat.inj_div2, Nat.div2_div. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* the family of VF states at the end offset: base (k0, Om0), cut R; all in N *)
Definition off_endN (k : N) : N := if N.eqb ((k + 20) mod 8) 3 then (k + 21)%N else (k + 20)%N.

Definition egr (k0 : N) : vrow := phrow (N.to_nat (off_endN k0 mod 8)).

Definition egL (k0 : N) : nat := N.to_nat (k0 + N.of_nat (vlam (egr k0)) - off_endN k0).

Definition egV (k0 : N) (Om0 : N) : N :=
  (N.of_nat (vmu (egr k0)) * Om0 + N.of_nat (val_ (egr k0)) * off_endN k0 + N.of_nat (vwp (egr k0)) -
   N.of_nat (vwn (egr k0) + 3 * 2 ^ (egL k0 - 1)))%N.

Definition egF (k0 : N) (Om0 : N) (R : nat) : fam :=
  let j0 := (Om0 + off_endN k0 - 64)%N in
  mkF (vlowN (vh (egr k0)) (egL k0) R (egV k0 Om0)) (egV k0 Om0 / 2 ^ N.of_nat R) 1
      (j0 - N.of_nat (vd (egr k0))) j0 (2 ^ N.of_nat R).

Definition egok (k0 : N) (Om0 : N) (R : nat) : bool :=
  Nat.ltb (egL k0) R && N.leb (2 ^ N.of_nat R) (egV k0 Om0) && N.leb 64 Om0 &&
  Nat.eqb (vmu (egr k0)) 1 && Nat.eqb (val_ (egr k0)) 1 && Nat.leb (vd (egr k0)) 20 &&
  frun 120 R (egF k0 Om0 R).

Definition egbase (kap : nat) : N := N.of_nat (if Nat.ltb kap 41 then kap + 4096 else kap).

Definition eg_ok (kap : nat) : bool :=
  Nat.eqb ((kap + 9) mod 2048) O || egok (egbase kap) (2 ^ 46) 12.

Lemma eg_all : forallb eg_ok (upto 4096) = true.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Definition ns_ok (v : nat) (s0 : N) : bool :=
  egok (s0 * 2 ^ N.of_nat v - 9) (2 ^ N.of_nat (v + 10)) (v + 2).

Lemma ns_all : forallb (fun v => ns_ok (v + 11) 1 && ns_ok (v + 11) 3) (upto 40) = true.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma off_endN_spec k : N.to_nat (off_endN k) = off_end (N.to_nat k).
Proof.
  unfold off_endN, off_end.
  replace (N.eqb ((k + 20) mod 8) 3) with (Nat.eqb ((N.to_nat k + 20) mod 8) 3).
  - destruct (Nat.eqb _ _); lia.
  - rewrite <- (N2Nat.id ((k + 20) mod 8)). rewrite N2Nat.inj_mod, N2Nat.inj_add.
    change (N.to_nat 20) with 20%nat. change (N.to_nat 8) with 8%nat.
    destruct (Nat.eqb_spec ((N.to_nat k + 20) mod 8) 3) as [E|E]; symmetry.
    + apply N.eqb_eq. rewrite E. reflexivity.
    + apply N.eqb_neq. intros C. apply E. apply (f_equal N.to_nat) in C. rewrite Nat2N.id in C. exact C.
Qed.

Lemma mod8_of k k0 R : 3 <= R -> k0 <= k -> (k - k0) mod 2 ^ R = O -> k mod 8 = k0 mod 8.
Proof.
  intros HR Hk H. apply Nat.Div0.mod_divides in H. destruct H as [c Hc].
  replace k with (k0 + (2 ^ (R - 3) * c) * 8).
  - apply Nat.Div0.mod_add.
  - replace R with (3 + (R - 3)) in Hc by lia. rewrite Nat.pow_add_r in Hc. cbn in Hc. lia.
Qed.

Lemma off_end_shift k k0 : k mod 8 = k0 mod 8 -> off_end k = k + (off_end k0 - k0) /\ k0 + 20 <= off_end k0 /\
  off_end k mod 8 = off_end k0 mod 8.
Proof.
  intros H. unfold off_end.
  assert (E : (k + 20) mod 8 = (k0 + 20) mod 8).
  { rewrite (Nat.Div0.add_mod k), (Nat.Div0.add_mod k0), H. reflexivity. }
  rewrite E. destruct (Nat.eqb ((k0 + 20) mod 8) 3); (split; [lia|split; [lia|]]).
  - replace (k + 21) with (k + 21) by reflexivity. rewrite (Nat.Div0.add_mod k), (Nat.Div0.add_mod k0), H. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (Nat.Div0.add_mod k), (Nat.Div0.add_mod k0), H. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma eg_family k0 Om0 R k Om : egok k0 Om0 R = true -> 3 <= R -> N.to_nat k0 <= k ->
  (k - N.to_nat k0) mod 2 ^ R = O -> N.to_nat Om0 <= Om -> (Om - N.to_nat Om0) mod 2 ^ R = O ->
  exists b', CSplus (VFe k Om) (Cst b').
Proof.
  intros Hok HR Hk HkR HO HOR.
  unfold egok in Hok.
  apply andb_prop in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok Hrun].
  apply andb_prop in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok Hd].
  apply andb_prop in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok Hal].
  apply andb_prop in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok Hmu].
  apply andb_prop in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok H64].
  apply andb_prop in Hok. destruct Hok as [HL HV].
  apply Nat.ltb_lt in HL. apply N.leb_le in HV, H64. apply Nat.eqb_eq in Hmu, Hal. apply Nat.leb_le in Hd.
  assert (Hpr := Nat.pow_nonzero 2 R ltac:(lia)).
  apply Nat.Div0.mod_divides in HkR, HOR. destruct HkR as [ck Hck], HOR as [cO HcO].
  set (u := cO + ck).
  destruct (frun_sound _ _ _ Hrun u) as [b' Hb']. exists b'.
  replace (VFe k Om) with (fz (egF k0 Om0 R) u); [exact Hb'|].
  set (n0 := N.to_nat k0) in *.
  assert (H8 : k mod 8 = n0 mod 8).
  { apply (mod8_of k n0 R); auto. rewrite Hck, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.Div0.mod_mul. reflexivity. }
  destruct (off_end_shift k n0 H8) as [Eoff [Hoff Eom]].
  set (off0 := off_end n0) in *.
  assert (Eo0 : N.to_nat (off_endN k0) = off0) by (unfold off0, n0; apply off_endN_spec).
  assert (Er : egr k0 = phrow (off_end k mod 8)).
  { unfold egr. rewrite Eom. f_equal. rewrite N2Nat.inj_mod, Eo0. reflexivity. }
  set (r := egr k0) in *.
  assert (EL : egL k0 = k + vlam r - off_end k).
  { unfold egL. fold r. rewrite N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_add, Nat2N.id, Eo0. fold n0. lia. }
  set (L := egL k0) in *.
  set (Om0' := N.to_nat Om0) in *.
  assert (EV0 : N.to_nat (egV k0 Om0) = Om0' + off0 + vwp r - (vwn r + 3 * 2 ^ (L - 1))).
  { unfold egV. fold r L. rewrite N2Nat.inj_sub, !N2Nat.inj_add, !N2Nat.inj_mul, !Nat2N.id, Eo0, Hmu, Hal.
    fold Om0'. lia. }
  set (V0 := N.to_nat (egV k0 Om0)) in *.
  assert (HV' : 2 ^ R <= V0).
  { unfold V0. replace (2 ^ R) with (N.to_nat (2 ^ N.of_nat R)) by (rewrite N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id; reflexivity). lia. }
  assert (EV : vmu r * Om + val_ r * off_end k + vwp r - (vwn r + 3 * 2 ^ (k + vlam r - off_end k - 1))
               = V0 + 2 ^ R * u).
  { rewrite <- EL. fold L. rewrite Hmu, Hal. unfold u. rewrite Eoff. lia. }
  unfold VFe, vfz. rewrite <- Er. fold r. rewrite EV, <- EL. fold L.
  unfold fz, egF. cbn [fX fy fay fD fj faD]. fold r L. rewrite vlowN_spec. fold V0.
  assert (Ep : N.to_nat (2 ^ N.of_nat R) = 2 ^ R) by (rewrite N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id; reflexivity).
  f_equal; [f_equal|].
  - rewrite (vfl_split (vh r) L R (V0 + 2 ^ R * u)) by lia.
    rewrite vlow_mod, div_mod_shift. f_equal. f_equal.
    rewrite N2Nat.inj_div, Ep. change (N.to_nat 1) with 1%nat. fold V0. lia.
  - rewrite Ep, N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_add, Eo0, Nat2N.id.
    change (N.to_nat 64) with 64%nat. fold Om0'. unfold u. rewrite Eoff.
    assert (64 <= Om0') by (unfold Om0'; lia). lia.
  - rewrite Ep, N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_add, Eo0.
    change (N.to_nat 64) with 64%nat. fold Om0'. unfold u. rewrite Eoff.
    assert (64 <= Om0') by (unfold Om0'; lia). lia.
Qed.

Lemma pow_le_mono2 a b : a <= b -> 2 ^ a <= 2 ^ b.
Proof. intros H. apply Nat.pow_le_mono_r; lia. Qed.

Lemma pow_mod_sub a b c U : c <= a -> c <= b -> 2 ^ b <= U * 2 ^ a -> (U * 2 ^ a - 2 ^ b) mod 2 ^ c = O.
Proof.
  intros Ha Hb H.
  replace a with (c + (a - c)) by lia. replace b with (c + (b - c)) by lia.
  rewrite !Nat.pow_add_r.
  replace (U * (2 ^ c * 2 ^ (a - c)) - 2 ^ c * 2 ^ (b - c)) with ((U * 2 ^ (a - c) - 2 ^ (b - c)) * 2 ^ c).
  - apply Nat.Div0.mod_mul.
  - rewrite Nat.mul_sub_distr_r. f_equal; lia.
Qed.

(* the endgame of proof.md 6.4 with the cut R = 12 (proof.md 10): nu2(k + 9) <= 10 *)
Theorem endgame k U : 41 <= k -> (k + 9) mod 2048 <> O -> 1 <= U ->
  exists b', CSplus (VFe k (U * 2 ^ (k + 5))) (Cst b').
Proof.
  intros Hk Hv HU.
  set (kap := k mod 4096).
  assert (Hkap : kap < 4096) by (apply Nat.mod_upper_bound; lia).
  pose proof eg_all as H. rewrite forallb_forall in H. specialize (H kap (upto_In _ _ Hkap)).
  unfold eg_ok in H.
  assert (Ev : (kap + 9) mod 2048 = (k + 9) mod 2048).
  { unfold kap. rewrite (Nat.div_mod_eq k 4096) at 2.
    replace (4096 * (k / 4096) + k mod 4096 + 9) with ((k mod 4096 + 9) + (2 * (k / 4096)) * 2048) by lia.
    rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_add. reflexivity. }
  rewrite Ev in H. destruct (Nat.eqb_spec ((k + 9) mod 2048) O) as [E|_]; [contradiction|]. cbn [orb] in H.
  assert (Ek : k = 4096 * (k / 4096) + kap) by (apply Nat.div_mod_eq).
  assert (E0 : N.to_nat (egbase kap) = if Nat.ltb kap 41 then kap + 4096 else kap).
  { unfold egbase. apply Nat2N.id. }
  assert (Hpk : 2 ^ 46 <= 2 ^ (k + 5)) by (apply pow_le_mono2; lia).
  eapply (eg_family (egbase kap) (2 ^ 46) 12); [exact H|lia| | | |].
  - rewrite E0. destruct (Nat.ltb_spec kap 41); [|lia].
    assert (1 <= k / 4096) by (destruct (k / 4096); lia). lia.
  - rewrite E0. replace (2 ^ 12) with 4096 by reflexivity.
    destruct (Nat.ltb_spec kap 41).
    + assert (1 <= k / 4096) by (destruct (k / 4096); lia).
      replace (k - (kap + 4096)) with ((k / 4096 - 1) * 4096) by lia. apply Nat.Div0.mod_mul.
    + replace (k - kap) with ((k / 4096) * 4096) by lia. apply Nat.Div0.mod_mul.
  - rewrite N2Nat.inj_pow. change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. change (N.to_nat 46) with 46%nat. nia.
  - rewrite N2Nat.inj_pow. change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. change (N.to_nat 46) with 46%nat.
    apply pow_mod_sub; [lia|lia|nia].
Qed.

(* the nested range of proof.md 6.5 for 11 <= v <= 50 (proof.md 10) *)
Theorem nested k U s v : k + 9 = s * 2 ^ v -> Nat.odd s = true -> 11 <= v <= 50 -> 1 <= U ->
  exists b', CSplus (VFe k (U * 2 ^ (k + 5))) (Cst b').
Proof.
  intros Hks Hs Hv HU.
  pose proof ns_all as H. rewrite forallb_forall in H.
  specialize (H (v - 11) (upto_In (v - 11) 40 ltac:(lia))). replace (v - 11 + 11) with v in H by lia.
  apply andb_prop in H. destruct H as [H1 H3].
  assert (Hpv := Nat.pow_nonzero 2 v ltac:(lia)).
  assert (Hv2 : 2 ^ 11 <= 2 ^ v) by (apply pow_le_mono2; lia).
  change (2 ^ 11) with 2048%nat in Hv2.
  assert (Hsm : s mod 4 = 1%nat \/ s mod 4 = 3).
  { rewrite Nat.odd_spec in Hs. destruct Hs as [m Hm]. subst s.
    pose proof (Nat.mod_upper_bound (2 * m + 1) 4 ltac:(lia)).
    assert (E : (2 * m + 1) mod 4 = (2 * (m mod 2) + 1) mod 4).
    { rewrite (Nat.div_mod_eq m 2) at 1.
      replace (2 * (2 * (m / 2) + m mod 2) + 1) with ((2 * (m mod 2) + 1) + (m / 2) * 4) by lia.
      apply Nat.Div0.mod_add. }
    pose proof (Nat.mod_upper_bound m 2 ltac:(lia)).
    destruct (m mod 2) as [|[|]] eqn:Em; [left|right|lia]; rewrite E; reflexivity. }
  assert (Hdec : s = 4 * (s / 4) + s mod 4) by apply Nat.div_mod_eq.
  assert (Hk5 : v + 10 <= k + 5).
  { assert (v + 6 <= 2 ^ v).
    { clear -Hv. assert (forall n, 4 <= n -> n + 6 <= 2 ^ n).
      { induction n; intros Hn; [lia|]. destruct (Nat.eq_dec n 3) as [->|]; [cbn; lia|].
        rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'. specialize (IHn ltac:(lia)). lia. }
      apply H; lia. }
    assert (1 <= s) by (destruct s; [discriminate|lia]). nia. }
  assert (Hpk : 2 ^ (v + 10) <= 2 ^ (k + 5)) by (apply pow_le_mono2; lia).
  destruct Hsm as [Hsm|Hsm]; rewrite Hsm in Hdec.
  - eapply (eg_family _ _ (v + 2) k _ H1); [lia| | | |].
    + rewrite N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_mul, N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id. change (N.to_nat 1) with 1%nat.
      change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. change (N.to_nat 9) with 9%nat. nia.
    + rewrite N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_mul, N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id. change (N.to_nat 1) with 1%nat.
      change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. change (N.to_nat 9) with 9%nat.
      replace (k - (1 * 2 ^ v - 9)) with ((s / 4) * 2 ^ (v + 2)).
      * apply Nat.Div0.mod_mul.
      * rewrite Nat.pow_add_r. change (2 ^ 2) with 4%nat. nia.
    + rewrite N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id. change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. nia.
    + rewrite N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id. change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. apply pow_mod_sub; [lia|lia|nia].
  - eapply (eg_family _ _ (v + 2) k _ H3); [lia| | | |].
    + rewrite N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_mul, N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id.
      change (N.to_nat 3) with 3%nat. change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. change (N.to_nat 9) with 9%nat. nia.
    + rewrite N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_mul, N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id.
      change (N.to_nat 3) with 3%nat. change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. change (N.to_nat 9) with 9%nat.
      replace (k - (3 * 2 ^ v - 9)) with ((s / 4) * 2 ^ (v + 2)).
      * apply Nat.Div0.mod_mul.
      * rewrite Nat.pow_add_r. change (2 ^ 2) with 4%nat. nia.
    + rewrite N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id. change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. nia.
    + rewrite N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id. change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. apply pow_mod_sub; [lia|lia|nia].
Qed.

Lemma odd_not_mod2048 s v : Nat.odd s = true -> v <= 10 -> (s * 2 ^ v) mod 2048 <> O.
Proof.
  intros Hs Hv E. apply Nat.Div0.mod_divides in E. destruct E as [t Ht].
  assert (E2 : 2048 = 2 ^ v * 2 ^ (11 - v)).
  { rewrite <- Nat.pow_add_r. replace (v + (11 - v)) with 11 by lia. reflexivity. }
  rewrite E2 in Ht.
  assert (Hp := Nat.pow_nonzero 2 v ltac:(lia)).
  assert (Es : s = 2 ^ (11 - v) * t).
  { apply (Nat.mul_cancel_r _ _ (2 ^ v)); [lia|]. rewrite Ht. lia. }
  replace (11 - v) with (S (10 - v)) in Es by lia. rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r' in Es.
  rewrite Es in Hs. rewrite <- Nat.mul_assoc in Hs. rewrite Nat.odd_mul in Hs. discriminate.
Qed.

(* E(K) of proof.md 6.5 for every K with nu2(K + 9) <= 50, without induction hypothesis *)
Theorem E_low K U s v : 41 <= K -> K + 9 = s * 2 ^ v -> Nat.odd s = true -> v <= 50 -> 1 <= U ->
  exists b', CSplus (VFe K (U * 2 ^ (K + 5))) (Cst b').
Proof.
  intros HK Hks Hs Hv HU.
  destruct (Nat.le_gt_cases v 10) as [Hle|Hgt].
  - apply endgame; [exact HK| |exact HU]. rewrite Hks. apply odd_not_mod2048; auto.
  - eapply nested; [exact Hks|exact Hs|lia|exact HU].
Qed.


(* ===================================================================== *)
(* 18. Counter words above a cut, and one closed-system step with a      *)
(*     concrete low part and an arbitrary counter word above it.         *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Definition ctr (Yc : nat -> list unt) : Prop := forall n e, IncN e (Yc n) (Yc (n + e)).

Lemma ctr_bin : ctr bin.
Proof. intros n e. apply IncN_bin. Qed.

Lemma vfl_nil m V : vfl [] m V = digits m V ++ uP :: bin (V / 2 ^ m).
Proof.
  revert V; induction m as [|m IH]; intros V.
  - cbn [vfl digits app]. rewrite Nat.pow_0_r, Nat.div_1_r. reflexivity.
  - cbn [vfl digits app hd tl]. rewrite IH. rewrite Nat.Div0.div_div, <- Nat.pow_succ_r'. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctr_vfl m : ctr (vfl [] m).
Proof.
  intros n e. rewrite !vfl_nil. apply IncN_digits. apply IncN_P.
  replace ((n + e) / 2 ^ m) with (n / 2 ^ m + (n mod 2 ^ m + e) / 2 ^ m).
  - apply IncN_bin.
  - pose proof (Nat.pow_nonzero 2 m ltac:(lia)).
    assert (E : n + e = (n mod 2 ^ m + e) + (n / 2 ^ m) * 2 ^ m) by (pose proof (Nat.div_mod_eq n (2 ^ m)); lia).
    rewrite E, Nat.div_add by lia. lia.
Qed.

Lemma astep X Yc n D j T0 e1 A X1 X3 :
  ctr Yc ->
  XN T0 X e1 (Ps A ++ X1) -> dhead X1 = true -> allb cleanu X1 = true ->
  T0 <= D + pj j ->
  shiftX (fill X1 (val X1 + (D + pj j + 3 * A - T0))) = Some X3 ->
  cs_step (X ++ Yc n) D j
    (X3 ++ Yc (n + (e1 + (val X1 + (D + pj j + 3 * A - T0)) / 2 ^ ndig X1))) (D + A) (S j).
Proof.
  intros HY H1 Hd Hc HT Hs.
  apply (cutstep X (Yc n) T0 e1 A X1 (D + pj j) ((val X1 + (D + pj j + 3 * A - T0)) / 2 ^ ndig X1)
           (fill X1 (val X1 + (D + pj j + 3 * A - T0))) D j
           (X3 ++ Yc (n + (e1 + (val X1 + (D + pj j + 3 * A - T0)) / 2 ^ ndig X1)))
           (Yc (n + (e1 + (val X1 + (D + pj j + 3 * A - T0)) / 2 ^ ndig X1))) H1 Hd).
  - apply (XN_clean X1 (D + pj j + 3 * A - T0) Hc).
  - exact HT.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply HY.
  - apply shiftX_app. exact Hs.
Qed.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* 19. Splitting value forms at a cut.                                   *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Lemma vlow_L hs L L' R V : R < L -> R < L' -> vlow hs L R V = vlow hs L' R V.
Proof.
  revert hs L L' V; induction R as [|R IH]; intros hs L L' V H1 H2.
  - destruct L, L'; try lia. reflexivity.
  - destruct L as [|L], L' as [|L']; try lia. cbn [vlow]. rewrite (IH (tl hs) L L' (V / 2)) by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma vfl_split_hi hs L R V : R < L -> length hs <= R ->
  vfl hs L V = vlow hs L R V ++ vfl [] (L - R) (V / 2 ^ R).
Proof.
  revert hs L V; induction R as [|R IH]; intros hs L V HL Hh.
  - destruct hs; [|cbn in Hh; lia]. destruct L as [|L]; [lia|].
    cbn [vlow app]. rewrite Nat.sub_0_r, Nat.pow_0_r, Nat.div_1_r. reflexivity.
  - destruct L as [|L]; [lia|]. cbn [vfl vlow]. rewrite <- app_assoc. cbn [app].
    rewrite (IH (tl hs) L (V / 2)) by (try lia; destruct hs; cbn in *; lia).
    replace (S L - S R) with (L - R) by lia.
    rewrite Nat.Div0.div_div, <- Nat.pow_succ_r'. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma vfl_split_le hs L R V : L <= R -> 2 ^ R <= V -> vfl hs L V = vlow hs L R V ++ bin (V / 2 ^ R).
Proof.
  revert hs R V; induction L as [|L IH]; intros hs R V HL HV.
  - cbn [vfl vlow app]. f_equal. apply digits_bin_split. exact HV.
  - destruct R as [|R]; [lia|]. cbn [vfl vlow]. rewrite <- app_assoc. cbn [app]. f_equal. f_equal.
    rewrite (IH (tl hs) R (V / 2)) by (try lia; rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r' in HV; apply Nat.div_le_lower_bound; lia).
    f_equal. f_equal. rewrite Nat.Div0.div_div. rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lsteqb_eq a b : lsteqb a b = true -> a = b.
Proof. unfold lsteqb. destruct (list_eq_dec unt_eq_dec a b); [auto|discriminate]. Qed.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* 20. One descent step of a value form (Lemma VS of proof.md 6.3),      *)
(*     symbolic in Omega, off and the marker height: the check runs the  *)
(*     first T0 = 4096 carries on the low 8 digits (with the heads, and  *)
(*     the marker when L <= 8), the rest of the carry phase by counter   *)
(*     arithmetic on residues, and the absorption shift; the identities *)
(*     on the coefficients of Omega, off and 2^(L-1) make the next state *)
(*     the next value form for every member.                             *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Definition vzf (r : vrow) (o L : nat) (low : bool) : Z :=
  (Z.of_nat (val_ r * o + vwp r) - Z.of_nat (vwn r) - (if low then Z.of_nat (3 * 2 ^ (L - 1)) else 0))%Z.

Definition vt0 (r : vrow) (off0 a : nat) (X1 : list unt) : Z :=
  (Z.of_nat (val X1 + off0 + pj off0 + 3 * a) - Z.of_nat (64 + vd r + 4096))%Z.

Definition vsrun (r : vrow) (off0 Lc : nat) : option (list unt * N * nat * list unt * list unt) :=
  match xfeed 4000 4096 (vlowN (vh r) Lc 8 (Z.to_N (vzf r off0 Lc (Nat.leb Lc 8) mod 256))) with
  | None => None
  | Some (Xt, e1) =>
    match splitP Xt with
    | (a, X1) =>
      match shiftX (fillN X1 (Z.to_N (vt0 r off0 a X1 mod 2 ^ Z.of_nat (ndig X1)))) with
      | None => None
      | Some X3 => Some (Xt, e1, a, X1, X3)
      end
    end
  end.

Definition vscond (fx : bool) (r r' : vrow) (off0 Lc : nat) (e1 : N) (a : nat) (X1 X3 : list unt) : bool :=
  let low := Nat.leb Lc 8 in
  let L2 := if low then Lc + ndig X3 - 8 else S (ndig X3) in
  dhead X1 && allb cleanu X1 && Nat.leb 5 Lc && Nat.leb Lc 9 &&
  Nat.eqb (vlam r' + 8) (vlam r + 1 + ndig X3) && Nat.eqb (vd r' + a) (vd r + 1) &&
  Nat.leb (length (vh r')) (ndig X3) && Nat.leb (length (vh r)) 8 && Nat.leb 9 (Lc + ndig X3) &&
  Nat.leb (ndig X1) 8 && Nat.leb (ndig X3) 8 && Nat.leb 1 L2 && Nat.leb L2 (if low then ndig X3 else S (ndig X3)) &&
  lsteqb X3 (vlowN (vh r') L2 (ndig X3) (Z.to_N (vzf r' (S off0) L2 low mod 2 ^ Z.of_nat (ndig X3)))) &&
  Z.eqb (vzf r off0 Lc low / 256 + Z.of_N e1 + vt0 r off0 a X1 / 2 ^ Z.of_nat (ndig X1))
        (vzf r' (S off0) L2 low / 2 ^ Z.of_nat (ndig X3)) &&
  Nat.eqb (vmu r + 2 ^ (8 - ndig X1)) (vmu r' * 2 ^ (8 - ndig X3)) &&
  (fx || Nat.eqb (val_ r + 2 ^ (8 - ndig X1)) (val_ r' * 2 ^ (8 - ndig X3))).

Definition vsok (fx : bool) (r r' : vrow) (off0 Lc : nat) : bool :=
  match vsrun r off0 Lc with
  | Some (Xt, e1, a, X1, X3) => vscond fx r r' off0 Lc e1 a X1 X3
  | None => false
  end.

Lemma vsrun_spec r off0 Lc Xt e1 a X1 X3 : vsrun r off0 Lc = Some (Xt, e1, a, X1, X3) ->
  xfeed 4000 4096 (vlowN (vh r) Lc 8 (Z.to_N (vzf r off0 Lc (Nat.leb Lc 8) mod 256))) = Some (Xt, e1) /\
  splitP Xt = (a, X1) /\
  shiftX (fillN X1 (Z.to_N (vt0 r off0 a X1 mod 2 ^ Z.of_nat (ndig X1)))) = Some X3.
Proof.
  unfold vsrun.
  destruct (xfeed 4000 4096 (vlowN (vh r) Lc 8 (Z.to_N (vzf r off0 Lc (Nat.leb Lc 8) mod 256)))) as [[Xt' e1']|];
    [|discriminate].
  destruct (splitP Xt') as [a' X1'] eqn:ES.
  destruct (shiftX (fillN X1' (Z.to_N (vt0 r off0 a' X1' mod 2 ^ Z.of_nat (ndig X1'))))) as [X3'|] eqn:Es;
    [|discriminate].
  intros H. injection H as <- <- <- <- <-. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Zdm (z : Z) (m : nat) : 0 < m -> z = (Z.of_nat m * (z / Z.of_nat m) + z mod Z.of_nat m)%Z /\
  (0 <= z mod Z.of_nat m < Z.of_nat m)%Z.
Proof. intros H. split; [apply Z.div_mod; lia | apply Z.mod_pos_bound; lia]. Qed.

Lemma pj_shift8 off0 a : a mod 8 = O -> pj (off0 + a) = pj off0.
Proof.
  intros Ha. rewrite (pj_mod (off0 + a)), (pj_mod off0). f_equal.
  rewrite Nat.Div0.add_mod, Ha, Nat.add_0_r, Nat.Div0.mod_mod. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma vs_core r r' L V L' V' X0 Yc n n' D j e1 A X1 r2 M2 X3 :
  ctr Yc ->
  vfl (vh r) L V = X0 ++ Yc n -> vfl (vh r') L' V' = X3 ++ Yc n' ->
  XN 4096 X0 e1 (Ps A ++ X1) -> dhead X1 = true -> allb cleanu X1 = true ->
  4096 <= D + pj j -> val X1 + (D + pj j + 3 * A - 4096) = r2 + 2 ^ ndig X1 * M2 -> r2 < 2 ^ ndig X1 ->
  shiftX (fill X1 r2) = Some X3 -> n' = n + (e1 + M2) ->
  cs_step (vfl (vh r) L V) D j (vfl (vh r') L' V') (D + A) (S j).
Proof.
  intros HY Hz Hz' HX Hd Hc HT Hm Hr Hs Hn.
  rewrite Hz, Hz'.
  assert (E2 : (val X1 + (D + pj j + 3 * A - 4096)) / 2 ^ ndig X1 = M2).
  { rewrite Hm, div_mod_shift, Nat.div_small by exact Hr. lia. }
  assert (Hs' : shiftX (fill X1 (val X1 + (D + pj j + 3 * A - 4096))) = Some X3).
  { rewrite Hm, fill_mod. exact Hs. }
  pose proof (astep X0 Yc n D j 4096 e1 A X1 X3 HY HX Hd Hc HT Hs') as H.
  rewrite E2, <- Hn in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Zpow_nat n : (2 ^ Z.of_nat n)%Z = Z.of_nat (2 ^ n).
Proof. rewrite Nat2Z.inj_pow. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma pow_split n : n <= 8 -> 2 ^ n * 2 ^ (8 - n) = 256.
Proof. intros H. rewrite <- Nat.pow_add_r. replace (n + (8 - n)) with 8 by lia. reflexivity. Qed.

(* the arithmetic of one descent step, on plain numbers *)
Lemma ar_main (mu al wp wn mu' al' wp' wn' w g off0 lc lc2 hc P1 P3 Pn Pn3 PL PL' vX p a vdr : nat)
  (e1 : N) (vz vz2 t0 : Z) :
  vz = (Z.of_nat (al * off0 + wp) - Z.of_nat wn - Z.of_nat lc)%Z ->
  vz2 = (Z.of_nat (al' * S off0 + wp') - Z.of_nat wn' - Z.of_nat lc2)%Z ->
  3 * PL = lc + 768 * hc -> 3 * PL' = lc2 + 3 * Pn3 * hc ->
  Pn * P1 = 256 -> Pn3 * P3 = 256 -> 0 < Pn -> 0 < Pn3 ->
  t0 = (Z.of_nat (vX + off0 + p + 3 * a) - Z.of_nat (64 + vdr + 4096))%Z ->
  (vz / 256 + Z.of_N e1 + t0 / Z.of_nat Pn = vz2 / Z.of_nat Pn3)%Z ->
  mu + P1 = mu' * P3 -> (al + P1 = al' * P3 \/ g = O) ->
  wn + 3 * PL + 256 <= mu * (256 * w) + al * (off0 + 256 * g) + wp ->
  4096 + 64 + vdr <= 256 * w + (off0 + 256 * g) ->
  4096 <= 256 * w + (off0 + 256 * g) - 64 - vdr + p ->
  exists Qn M2 Q'n,
    mu * (256 * w) + al * (off0 + 256 * g) + wp - (wn + 3 * PL) = Z.to_nat (vz mod 256) + 256 * Qn /\
    Z.to_nat (vz mod 256) < 256 /\ 1 <= Qn /\
    vX + (256 * w + (off0 + 256 * g) - 64 - vdr + p + 3 * a - 4096) = Z.to_nat (t0 mod Z.of_nat Pn) + Pn * M2 /\
    Z.to_nat (t0 mod Z.of_nat Pn) < Pn /\
    mu' * (256 * w) + al' * S (off0 + 256 * g) + wp' - (wn' + 3 * PL') =
      Z.to_nat (vz2 mod Z.of_nat Pn3) + Pn3 * Q'n /\
    Z.to_nat (vz2 mod Z.of_nat Pn3) < Pn3 /\
    Q'n = Qn + (N.to_nat e1 + M2).
Proof.
  intros Hvz Hvz2 HPL HPL' HPn HPn3 Hp Hp3 Ht0 Hq Hmu Hal HV Hc HT.
  destruct (Zdm vz 256 ltac:(lia)) as [Ev Bv]. change (Z.of_nat 256) with 256%Z in Ev, Bv.
  destruct (Zdm t0 Pn Hp) as [Et Bt]. destruct (Zdm vz2 Pn3 Hp3) as [Ev2 Bv2].
  set (Qz := (vz / 256 + Z.of_nat (mu * w + al * g) - 3 * Z.of_nat hc)%Z).
  set (M2z := (t0 / Z.of_nat Pn + Z.of_nat P1 * Z.of_nat (w + g))%Z).
  set (Q'z := (vz2 / Z.of_nat Pn3 + Z.of_nat P3 * Z.of_nat (mu' * w + al' * g) - 3 * Z.of_nat hc)%Z).
  assert (EV : Z.of_nat (mu * (256 * w) + al * (off0 + 256 * g) + wp - (wn + 3 * PL)) = (vz mod 256 + 256 * Qz)%Z).
  { unfold Qz. clear -Hvz HPL HV Ev. lia. }
  assert (HQ : (1 <= Qz)%Z) by (clear -EV HV Bv; lia).
  assert (E256 : (Z.of_nat Pn * (Z.of_nat P1 * Z.of_nat (w + g)) = 256 * Z.of_nat (w + g))%Z).
  { rewrite Z.mul_assoc, <- Nat2Z.inj_mul, HPn. reflexivity. }
  assert (ET : Z.of_nat (vX + (256 * w + (off0 + 256 * g) - 64 - vdr + p + 3 * a - 4096)) =
               (t0 mod Z.of_nat Pn + Z.of_nat Pn * M2z)%Z).
  { unfold M2z. rewrite Z.mul_add_distr_l, E256. clear -Ht0 Hc HT Et. lia. }
  assert (HM : (0 <= M2z)%Z).
  { assert ((0 <= Z.of_nat (vX + (256 * w + (off0 + 256 * g) - 64 - vdr + p + 3 * a - 4096)))%Z) by lia.
    clear -ET Bt H Hp. nia. }
  assert (E256' : (Z.of_nat Pn3 * (Z.of_nat P3 * Z.of_nat (mu' * w + al' * g)) = 256 * Z.of_nat (mu' * w + al' * g))%Z).
  { rewrite Z.mul_assoc, <- Nat2Z.inj_mul, HPn3. reflexivity. }
  assert (EV' : (Z.of_nat (mu' * (256 * w) + al' * S (off0 + 256 * g) + wp') - Z.of_nat (wn' + 3 * PL') =
                 vz2 mod Z.of_nat Pn3 + Z.of_nat Pn3 * Q'z)%Z).
  { unfold Q'z. rewrite Z.mul_sub_distr_l, Z.mul_add_distr_l, E256'.
    assert ((Z.of_nat (3 * PL') = Z.of_nat lc2 + 3 * (Z.of_nat Pn3 * Z.of_nat hc))%Z) by (rewrite HPL'; lia).
    clear -Hvz2 H Ev2. lia. }
  assert (HQQ : Q'z = (Qz + Z.of_N e1 + M2z)%Z).
  { unfold Q'z, Qz, M2z.
    assert (Hm1 : (Z.of_nat P3 * Z.of_nat (mu' * w) = Z.of_nat (mu * w + P1 * w))%Z).
    { rewrite <- Nat2Z.inj_mul. f_equal. replace (mu * w + P1 * w) with ((mu + P1) * w) by ring.
      rewrite Hmu. ring. }
    assert (Hm2 : (Z.of_nat P3 * Z.of_nat (al' * g) = Z.of_nat (al * g + P1 * g))%Z).
    { rewrite <- Nat2Z.inj_mul. f_equal. destruct Hal as [Hal|Hal].
      - replace (al * g + P1 * g) with ((al + P1) * g) by ring. rewrite Hal. ring.
      - subst g. ring. }
    rewrite Nat2Z.inj_add, Z.mul_add_distr_l, Hm1, Hm2.
    clear -Hq. rewrite <- Hq. lia. }
  exists (Z.to_nat Qz), (Z.to_nat M2z), (Z.to_nat Q'z).
  assert (HQ' : (1 <= Q'z)%Z) by (rewrite HQQ; clear -HQ HM; lia).
  split; [|split; [|split; [|split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]]]]].
  - apply Nat2Z.inj. rewrite EV, Nat2Z.inj_add, Nat2Z.inj_mul, !Z2Nat.id by lia. reflexivity.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - apply Nat2Z.inj. rewrite ET, Nat2Z.inj_add, Nat2Z.inj_mul, !Z2Nat.id by lia. reflexivity.
  - lia.
  - apply Nat2Z.inj. rewrite Nat2Z.inj_sub.
    + rewrite EV', Nat2Z.inj_add, Nat2Z.inj_mul, !Z2Nat.id by lia. reflexivity.
    + apply Nat2Z.inj_le. clear -EV' Bv2 HQ' Hp3. nia.
  - lia.
  - rewrite HQQ. apply Nat2Z.inj. rewrite !Nat2Z.inj_add, N_nat_Z, !Z2Nat.id by lia. lia.
Qed.

Lemma ar_pj w g off0 : off0 < 256 -> 4160 <= 256 * w + (off0 + 256 * g) ->
  pj (256 * w + (off0 + 256 * g) - 64) = pj off0.
Proof.
  intros H1 H2. replace (256 * w + (off0 + 256 * g) - 64) with (off0 + (32 * w + 32 * g - 8) * 8) by lia.
  apply pj_shift8. apply Nat.Div0.mod_mul.
Qed.

Lemma if_true A (x y : A) : (if true then x else y) = x.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma if_false A (x y : A) : (if false then x else y) = y.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma vs_gen fx r r' off0 Lc g w k off :
  vsok fx r r' off0 Lc = true -> off0 < 256 ->
  off = off0 + 256 * g -> (fx = true -> g = O) ->
  (Lc <= 8 /\ k + vlam r - off = Lc \/ Lc = 9 /\ 9 <= k + vlam r - off) ->
  vwn r + 3 * 2 ^ (k + vlam r - off - 1) + 256 <= vmu r * (256 * w) + val_ r * off + vwp r ->
  4096 + 64 + vd r <= 256 * w + off ->
  CS (vfz r k (256 * w) off) (vfz r' k (256 * w) (S off)).
Proof.
  intros Hok Ho0 Hoff Hfx HLc HV Hc. subst off.
  (* PITFALL: destructing [vsrun ..] inside the hypothesis makes Qed hang; destruct in the goal *)
  revert Hok. unfold vsok.
  destruct (vsrun r off0 Lc) as [[[[[Xt e1] a] X1] X3]|] eqn:Er; [|intros Hok; discriminate Hok].
  intros Hok.
  destruct (vsrun_spec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Er) as [Ex [ES Es]]. clear Er.
  unfold vscond in Hok.
  repeat rewrite Bool.andb_true_iff in Hok.
  destruct Hok as [[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[Hd Hcl] H5] H9] Hlam] Hvd] Hlh'] Hlh] H9n] Hnd] Hnd3] HL21] HL22] HX3] Hq] Hmu] Hal].
  apply Nat.leb_le in H5, H9, Hlh', Hlh, H9n, Hnd, Hnd3, HL21, HL22.
  apply Nat.eqb_eq in Hlam, Hvd, Hmu.
  apply lsteqb_eq in HX3. apply Z.eqb_eq in Hq.
  assert (Hal' : val_ r + 2 ^ (8 - ndig X1) = val_ r' * 2 ^ (8 - ndig X3) \/ g = O).
  { destruct fx; [right; apply Hfx; reflexivity | left; apply Nat.eqb_eq; exact Hal]. }
  clear Hal.
  apply xfeed_sound in Ex. change (N.to_nat 4096) with 4096%nat in Ex.
  pose proof (splitP_spec Xt) as HS. rewrite ES in HS. destruct HS as [EXt _]. rewrite EXt in Ex.
  rewrite fillN_spec, Z_N_nat in Es. rewrite vlowN_spec, Z_N_nat in Ex, HX3.
  rewrite (Zpow_nat (ndig X1)) in Es, Hq. rewrite (Zpow_nat (ndig X3)) in Hq, HX3.
  set (t0 := vt0 r off0 a X1) in *.
  set (vz := vzf r off0 Lc (Nat.leb Lc 8)) in *.
  set (L2 := if Nat.leb Lc 8 then Lc + ndig X3 - 8 else S (ndig X3)) in *.
  set (vz2 := vzf r' (S off0) L2 (Nat.leb Lc 8)) in *.
  assert (HPn : 2 ^ ndig X1 * 2 ^ (8 - ndig X1) = 256) by (apply pow_split; exact Hnd).
  assert (HPn3 : 2 ^ ndig X3 * 2 ^ (8 - ndig X3) = 256) by (apply pow_split; exact Hnd3).
  assert (Pn_pos : 0 < 2 ^ ndig X1) by (apply Nat.neq_0_lt_0, Nat.pow_nonzero; lia).
  assert (Pn3_pos : 0 < 2 ^ ndig X3) by (apply Nat.neq_0_lt_0, Nat.pow_nonzero; lia).
  set (j := 256 * w + (off0 + 256 * g) - 64).
  assert (Hpj : pj j = pj off0) by (apply ar_pj; [exact Ho0|clear -Hc; lia]).
  assert (HT : 4096 <= 256 * w + (off0 + 256 * g) - 64 - vd r + pj off0) by (clear -Hc; lia).
  assert (HT' : 4096 <= j - vd r + pj j) by (rewrite Hpj; exact HT).
  unfold CS, vfz. cbn [fst snd]. fold j.
  replace (256 * w + S (off0 + 256 * g) - 64 - vd r') with (j - vd r + a) by (clear -Hvd Hc; unfold j; lia).
  replace (256 * w + S (off0 + 256 * g) - 64) with (S j) by (clear -Hc; unfold j; lia).
  set (L := k + vlam r - (off0 + 256 * g)) in *.
  set (L' := k + vlam r' - S (off0 + 256 * g)).
  assert (EL' : L' = L + ndig X3 - 8) by (clear -Hlam HLc H5 H9n; unfold L', L; lia).
  set (V := vmu r * (256 * w) + val_ r * (off0 + 256 * g) + vwp r - (vwn r + 3 * 2 ^ (L - 1))).
  set (V' := vmu r' * (256 * w) + val_ r' * S (off0 + 256 * g) + vwp r' - (vwn r' + 3 * 2 ^ (L' - 1))).
  destruct HLc as [[HLc HL]|[HLc HL]].
  - (* marker below the cut: the upper part is bin *)
    assert (Elow : Nat.leb Lc 8 = true) by (apply Nat.leb_le; exact HLc).
    assert (EL2 : L2 = Lc + ndig X3 - 8) by (unfold L2; rewrite Elow; reflexivity).
    destruct (ar_main (vmu r) (val_ r) (vwp r) (vwn r) (vmu r') (val_ r') (vwp r') (vwn r') w g off0
                (3 * 2 ^ (Lc - 1)) (3 * 2 ^ (L2 - 1)) 0 (2 ^ (8 - ndig X1)) (2 ^ (8 - ndig X3))
                (2 ^ ndig X1) (2 ^ ndig X3) (2 ^ (L - 1)) (2 ^ (L' - 1)) (val X1) (pj off0) a (vd r) e1 vz vz2 t0)
      as [Qn [M2 [Q'n [EV [Bv [HQ [ET [Bt [EV' [Bv' EQ]]]]]]]]]].
    + unfold vz, vzf. rewrite Elow. reflexivity.
    + unfold vz2, vzf. rewrite Elow. reflexivity.
    + rewrite HL. lia.
    + replace L' with L2 by (rewrite EL', EL2, HL; reflexivity). lia.
    + exact HPn.
    + exact HPn3.
    + exact Pn_pos.
    + exact Pn3_pos.
    + unfold t0, vt0. reflexivity.
    + exact Hq.
    + exact Hmu.
    + exact Hal'.
    + exact HV.
    + exact Hc.
    + exact HT.
    + fold V in EV. fold V' in EV'.
      set (v0n := Z.to_nat (vz mod 256)) in *. set (r2n := Z.to_nat (t0 mod Z.of_nat (2 ^ ndig X1))) in *.
      set (v02n := Z.to_nat (vz2 mod Z.of_nat (2 ^ ndig X3))) in *.
      clearbody v0n r2n v02n. clear Hq Hmu Hal'.
      assert (Hz : vfl (vh r) L V = vlow (vh r) Lc 8 v0n ++ bin Qn).
      { rewrite (vfl_split_le (vh r) L 8 V) by (change (2 ^ 8) with 256; lia).
        rewrite EV. change 256 with (2 ^ 8). rewrite vlow_mod, div_mod_shift, Nat.div_small by exact Bv.
        rewrite HL. reflexivity. }
      assert (Hz' : vfl (vh r') L' V' = X3 ++ bin Q'n).
      { rewrite (vfl_split_le (vh r') L' (ndig X3) V').
        - rewrite EV', vlow_mod, div_mod_shift, Nat.div_small, Nat.add_0_l by exact Bv'.
          replace L' with L2 by (rewrite EL', EL2, HL; reflexivity). rewrite <- HX3. reflexivity.
        - rewrite EL', HL. rewrite EL2 in HL22. rewrite Elow in HL22. lia.
        - rewrite EV'. nia. }
      eapply (vs_core r r' L V L' V' _ bin Qn Q'n (j - vd r) j (N.to_nat e1) a X1 _ M2 X3 ctr_bin Hz Hz' Ex Hd Hcl HT').
      * rewrite Hpj. unfold j. exact ET.
      * exact Bt.
      * exact Es.
      * exact EQ.
  - (* marker above the cut: the upper part is a digit word with the marker *)
    assert (Ehi : Nat.leb Lc 8 = false) by (apply Nat.leb_gt; lia).
    assert (EL2 : L2 = S (ndig X3)) by (unfold L2; rewrite Ehi; reflexivity).
    subst Lc.
    destruct (ar_main (vmu r) (val_ r) (vwp r) (vwn r) (vmu r') (val_ r') (vwp r') (vwn r') w g off0
                0 0 (2 ^ (L - 9)) (2 ^ (8 - ndig X1)) (2 ^ (8 - ndig X3))
                (2 ^ ndig X1) (2 ^ ndig X3) (2 ^ (L - 1)) (2 ^ (L' - 1)) (val X1) (pj off0) a (vd r) e1 vz vz2 t0)
      as [Qn [M2 [Q'n [EV [Bv [HQ [ET [Bt [EV' [Bv' EQ]]]]]]]]]].
    + unfold vz, vzf. rewrite Ehi. reflexivity.
    + unfold vz2, vzf. rewrite Ehi. reflexivity.
    + replace (L - 1) with (8 + (L - 9)) by lia. rewrite Nat.pow_add_r. change (2 ^ 8) with 256. lia.
    + replace (L' - 1) with (ndig X3 + (L - 9)) by lia. rewrite Nat.pow_add_r. lia.
    + exact HPn.
    + exact HPn3.
    + exact Pn_pos.
    + exact Pn3_pos.
    + unfold t0, vt0. reflexivity.
    + exact Hq.
    + exact Hmu.
    + exact Hal'.
    + exact HV.
    + exact Hc.
    + exact HT.
    + fold V in EV. fold V' in EV'.
      set (v0n := Z.to_nat (vz mod 256)) in *. set (r2n := Z.to_nat (t0 mod Z.of_nat (2 ^ ndig X1))) in *.
      set (v02n := Z.to_nat (vz2 mod Z.of_nat (2 ^ ndig X3))) in *.
      clearbody v0n r2n v02n. clear Hq Hmu Hal'.
      assert (Hz : vfl (vh r) L V = vlow (vh r) 9 8 v0n ++ vfl [] (L - 8) Qn).
      { rewrite (vfl_split_hi (vh r) L 8 V) by lia.
        rewrite (vlow_L (vh r) L 9 8 V) by lia.
        rewrite EV. change 256 with (2 ^ 8). rewrite vlow_mod, div_mod_shift, Nat.div_small by exact Bv.
        reflexivity. }
      assert (Hz' : vfl (vh r') L' V' = X3 ++ vfl [] (L - 8) Q'n).
      { rewrite (vfl_split_hi (vh r') L' (ndig X3) V') by lia.
        replace (L' - ndig X3) with (L - 8) by lia.
        rewrite (vlow_L (vh r') L' (S (ndig X3)) (ndig X3) V') by lia.
        rewrite EV', vlow_mod, div_mod_shift, Nat.div_small, Nat.add_0_l by exact Bv'.
        rewrite <- EL2, <- HX3. reflexivity. }
      eapply (vs_core r r' L V L' V' _ (vfl [] (L - 8)) Qn Q'n (j - vd r) j (N.to_nat e1) a X1 _ M2 X3
                (ctr_vfl (L - 8)) Hz Hz' Ex Hd Hcl HT').
      * rewrite Hpj. unfold j. exact ET.
      * exact Bt.
      * exact Es.
      * exact EQ.
Qed.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* 21. The value-form tables (proof.md 6.2): the entry table for level 1 *)
(*     at off 20..31 and the phase table elsewhere; the finite checks.   *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Definition enrows : list vrow :=
  [ mkV [[]; [uS1]] 24 1 0 0 0 2;
    mkV [[]; [uSP]] 25 2 0 0 0 3;
    mkV [[uS1; uP; uP]] 24 1 0 0 2 4;
    mkV [[]; []; []; [uS1]] 24 1 0 0 0 2;
    mkV [[]; []; [uS1; uP]] 24 1 0 0 4 3;
    mkV [[]; []; [uSP; uP]] 25 2 0 0 4 4;
    mkV [[uS1]; [uP; uP; uP]] 24 1 0 0 4 5;
    mkV [[uS1; uP; uP; uP]] 24 1 0 1 0 5;
    mkV [[uS1]] 24 1 0 8 0 2;
    mkV [[]; []; [uS1]] 24 1 0 8 0 2;
    mkV [[]; [uS1; uP]] 24 1 0 6 0 3;
    mkV [[uS1; uP; uP]] 24 1 0 7 0 4 ].

Definition row1 (off : nat) : vrow :=
  if Nat.leb off 31 then nth (off - 20) enrows (phrow 0) else phrow (off mod 8).

Definition en_ok (i : nat) : bool := vsok true (row1 (20 + i)) (row1 (21 + i)) (20 + i) 9.

Definition lcs : list nat := [5%nat; 6; 7; 8; 9].

Definition ph_ok (o : nat) : bool :=
  forallb (fun Lc => vsok false (phrow (o mod 8)) (phrow (S o mod 8)) o Lc) lcs.

(* PITFALL: state the vm_compute facts over named predicates; a named
   [Definition x := forallb (fun ..) ..] makes the kernel evaluate the
   checks lazily when it is unfolded in a conversion *)
(* the kernel must unfold these before vsok, or it evaluates vsok lazily *)
Strategy expand [en_ok ph_ok].

Lemma en_all : forallb en_ok (upto 12) = true.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ph_all : forallb ph_ok (upto 256) = true.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

(* bounds on the rows *)
Definition rowok (r : vrow) : bool :=
  Nat.leb 1 (vmu r) && Nat.leb (vwn r) 42 && Nat.leb (vd r) 5 && Nat.leb 24 (vlam r) && Nat.leb (vlam r) 25.

Lemma nth_rowok l d n : forallb rowok l = true -> rowok d = true -> rowok (nth n l d) = true.
Proof.
  revert n; induction l as [|x l IH]; intros n H Hd; destruct n; cbn in *; auto;
    apply andb_prop in H; destruct H; auto.
Qed.

Lemma phrow_ok phi : rowok (phrow phi) = true.
Proof. unfold phrow. apply nth_rowok; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma row1_ok off : rowok (row1 off) = true.
Proof. unfold row1. destruct (Nat.leb off 31); [apply nth_rowok; [reflexivity|apply phrow_ok]|apply phrow_ok]. Qed.

Lemma rowok_spec r : rowok r = true -> 1 <= vmu r /\ vwn r <= 42 /\ vd r <= 5 /\ 24 <= vlam r <= 25.
Proof.
  unfold rowok. intros H. repeat rewrite Bool.andb_true_iff in H.
  destruct H as [[[[H1 H2] H3] H4] H5]. apply Nat.leb_le in H1, H2, H3, H4, H5. lia.
Qed.

Lemma row1_lam off : 20 <= off -> vlam (row1 off) <= off + 4.
Proof.
  intros H. destruct (Nat.le_gt_cases off 31) as [Hle|Hgt].
  - assert (E : off = 20 + (off - 20)) by lia. rewrite E.
    assert (Hi : off - 20 < 12) by lia.
    generalize (off - 20) Hi. clear. intros i Hi.
    assert (Hc : forallb (fun i => Nat.leb (vlam (row1 (20 + i))) (20 + i + 4)) (upto 12) = true) by reflexivity.
    rewrite forallb_forall in Hc. apply Nat.leb_le. apply Hc. apply upto_In. exact Hi.
  - destruct (rowok_spec _ (row1_ok off)). lia.
Qed.

Lemma mod8_256 off : (off mod 256) mod 8 = off mod 8.
Proof.
  rewrite (Nat.div_mod_eq off 256) at 2.
  replace (256 * (off / 256) + off mod 256) with (off mod 256 + (32 * (off / 256)) * 8) by lia.
  rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_add. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma Smod8_256 off : S (off mod 256) mod 8 = S off mod 8.
Proof.
  rewrite (Nat.div_mod_eq off 256) at 2.
  replace (S (256 * (off / 256) + off mod 256)) with (S (off mod 256) + (32 * (off / 256)) * 8) by lia.
  rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_add. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* PITFALL: rewriting inside a hypothesis that mentions vsok makes Qed hang;
   take the boolean facts as plain terms and rewrite only goals *)
Lemma en_at i : i < 12 -> vsok true (row1 (20 + i)) (row1 (21 + i)) (20 + i) 9 = true.
Proof. intros Hi. exact (proj1 (forallb_forall en_ok (upto 12)) en_all i (upto_In _ _ Hi)). Qed.

Lemma ph_at o Lc : o < 256 -> In Lc lcs -> vsok false (phrow (o mod 8)) (phrow (S o mod 8)) o Lc = true.
Proof.
  intros Ho HL.
  exact (proj1 (forallb_forall (fun Lc => vsok false (phrow (o mod 8)) (phrow (S o mod 8)) o Lc) lcs)
           (proj1 (forallb_forall ph_ok (upto 256)) ph_all o (upto_In _ _ Ho)) Lc HL).
Qed.

(* one descent step with a phase row *)
Lemma vs_ph k w off :
  5 <= k + vlam (phrow (off mod 8)) - off ->
  vwn (phrow (off mod 8)) + 3 * 2 ^ (k + vlam (phrow (off mod 8)) - off - 1) + 256 <=
    vmu (phrow (off mod 8)) * (256 * w) + val_ (phrow (off mod 8)) * off + vwp (phrow (off mod 8)) ->
  4096 + 64 + vd (phrow (off mod 8)) <= 256 * w + off ->
  CS (vfz (phrow (off mod 8)) k (256 * w) off) (vfz (phrow (S off mod 8)) k (256 * w) (S off)).
Proof.
  intros HL HV Hc.
  set (L := k + vlam (phrow (off mod 8)) - off) in *.
  set (Lc := if Nat.leb L 8 then L else 9).
  assert (HLc : In Lc lcs) by (unfold Lc, lcs; destruct (Nat.leb_spec L 8); cbn; lia).
  assert (Ho : off mod 256 < 256) by (apply Nat.mod_upper_bound; lia).
  rewrite <- (mod8_256 off), <- (Smod8_256 off).
  apply (vs_gen false _ _ (off mod 256) Lc (off / 256) w k off (ph_at _ _ Ho HLc) Ho).
  - pose proof (Nat.div_mod_eq off 256). lia.
  - discriminate.
  - rewrite mod8_256. unfold Lc. fold L. destruct (Nat.leb_spec L 8); [left|right]; lia.
  - rewrite mod8_256. exact HV.
  - rewrite mod8_256. exact Hc.
Qed.

(* one descent step with an entry row (level 1, off 20..31) *)
Lemma vs_en k w off :
  20 <= off <= 31 -> 9 <= k + vlam (row1 off) - off ->
  vwn (row1 off) + 3 * 2 ^ (k + vlam (row1 off) - off - 1) + 256 <=
    vmu (row1 off) * (256 * w) + val_ (row1 off) * off + vwp (row1 off) ->
  4096 + 64 + vd (row1 off) <= 256 * w + off ->
  CS (vfz (row1 off) k (256 * w) off) (vfz (row1 (S off)) k (256 * w) (S off)).
Proof.
  intros Ho HL HV Hc.
  assert (Hi : off - 20 < 12) by lia.
  assert (E : off = 20 + (off - 20)) by lia.
  remember (off - 20) as i eqn:Ei. clear Ei. subst off.
  apply (vs_gen true (row1 (20 + i)) (row1 (21 + i)) (20 + i) 9 0 w k (20 + i) (en_at i Hi)); lia.
Qed.

Inductive CSstar : st -> st -> Prop :=
| CSs0 s : CSstar s s
| CSsS s s1 s' : CS s s1 -> CSstar s1 s' -> CSstar s s'.

Lemma CSstar_snoc a b c : CSstar a b -> CS b c -> CSstar a c.
Proof.
  intros H1. induction H1 as [s|s s1 s' Hs H1 IH]; intros H2.
  - econstructor; [exact H2|constructor].
  - econstructor; [exact Hs|]. apply IH. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma CSstar_plus a b c : CSstar a b -> CSplus b c -> CSplus a c.
Proof.
  intros H1. induction H1 as [s|s s1 s' Hs H1 IH]; intros H2.
  - exact H2.
  - eapply CSpS; [exact Hs|]. apply IH. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma descent (rowf : nat -> vrow) k Om a b :
  (forall x, a <= x < b -> CS (vfz (rowf x) k Om x) (vfz (rowf (S x)) k Om (S x))) -> a <= b ->
  CSstar (vfz (rowf a) k Om a) (vfz (rowf b) k Om b).
Proof.
  intros H Hab. replace b with (a + (b - a)) by lia.
  assert (Hn : forall n, a + n <= b -> CSstar (vfz (rowf a) k Om a) (vfz (rowf (a + n)) k Om (a + n))).
  { induction n as [|n IH]; intros Hn.
    - rewrite Nat.add_0_r. constructor.
    - eapply CSstar_snoc; [apply IH; lia|]. replace (a + S n) with (S (a + n)) by lia. apply H. lia. }
  apply Hn. lia.
Qed.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* 22. Lemma VF (proof.md 6.3): the value form is carried from off 20    *)
(*     (level 1) or off' 17 (level 2) down to off_end.                   *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Lemma off_end_L5 k x l : x < off_end k -> 24 <= l -> (x = k + 20 -> l = 25) -> 5 <= k + l - x.
Proof.
  unfold off_end. intros Hx Hl H25.
  destruct (Nat.eqb ((k + 20) mod 8) 3); [|lia].
  destruct (Nat.eq_dec x (k + 20)) as [E|E]; [specialize (H25 E); lia|lia].
Qed.

Lemma off_end_phase3 k x : x < off_end k -> x = k + 20 -> x mod 8 = 3.
Proof.
  unfold off_end. intros Hx E. subst x.
  destruct (Nat.eqb_spec ((k + 20) mod 8) 3); [assumption|lia].
Qed.

Lemma pow_ge k a : a <= k -> 2 ^ a <= 2 ^ k.
Proof. intros H. apply Nat.pow_le_mono_r; lia. Qed.

Theorem VF1 k o : 41 <= k -> 1 <= o ->
  CSstar (vfz (row1 20) k (o * 2 ^ (k + 5)) 20) (VFe k (o * 2 ^ (k + 5))).
Proof.
  intros Hk Ho.
  set (T := 2 ^ (k + 3)).
  assert (HT : 4096 <= T) by (unfold T; change 4096 with (2 ^ 12); apply pow_ge; lia).
  set (w := o * 2 ^ (k - 3)).
  assert (Ew : o * 2 ^ (k + 5) = 256 * w).
  { unfold w. replace (k + 5) with (8 + (k - 3)) by lia. rewrite Nat.pow_add_r. change (2 ^ 8) with 256. lia. }
  assert (Ew' : 256 * w = o * (4 * T)).
  { rewrite <- Ew. unfold T. replace (k + 5) with (2 + (k + 3)) by lia. rewrite Nat.pow_add_r. reflexivity. }
  rewrite Ew. unfold VFe.
  assert (Hend : 61 <= off_end k) by (unfold off_end; destruct (Nat.eqb _ _); lia).
  assert (Er : phrow (off_end k mod 8) = row1 (off_end k)).
  { unfold row1. replace (Nat.leb (off_end k) 31) with false; [reflexivity|symmetry; apply Nat.leb_gt; lia]. }
  rewrite Er.
  apply descent; [|lia].
  intros x Hx.
  destruct (rowok_spec _ (row1_ok x)) as [Hmu [Hwn [Hvd [Hl1 Hl2]]]].
  assert (HLx : vlam (row1 x) <= x + 4) by (apply row1_lam; lia).
  assert (HL5 : 5 <= k + vlam (row1 x) - x).
  { apply off_end_L5; [lia|lia|]. intros E.
    assert (E3 := off_end_phase3 k x ltac:(lia) E).
    unfold row1. replace (Nat.leb x 31) with false by (symmetry; apply Nat.leb_gt; lia).
    rewrite E3. reflexivity. }
  assert (HP : 2 ^ (k + vlam (row1 x) - x - 1) <= T) by (unfold T; apply pow_ge; lia).
  assert (Hm : 256 * w <= vmu (row1 x) * (256 * w)) by nia.
  assert (HV : vwn (row1 x) + 3 * 2 ^ (k + vlam (row1 x) - x - 1) + 256 <=
               vmu (row1 x) * (256 * w) + val_ (row1 x) * x + vwp (row1 x)) by nia.
  assert (Hc : 4096 + 64 + vd (row1 x) <= 256 * w + x) by nia.
  destruct (Nat.le_gt_cases x 31) as [Hle|Hgt].
  - apply vs_en; [lia|lia|exact HV|exact Hc].
  - assert (E1 : row1 x = phrow (x mod 8)).
    { unfold row1. replace (Nat.leb x 31) with false by (symmetry; apply Nat.leb_gt; lia). reflexivity. }
    assert (E2 : row1 (S x) = phrow (S x mod 8)).
    { unfold row1. replace (Nat.leb (S x) 31) with false by (symmetry; apply Nat.leb_gt; lia). reflexivity. }
    rewrite E1, E2. rewrite E1 in HL5, HV, Hc. apply vs_ph; assumption.
Qed.

Theorem VF2 v S : 12 <= v -> 2 <= S ->
  CSstar (vfz (phrow 1) (v - 10) (S * 2 ^ v) 17) (VFe (v - 10) (S * 2 ^ v)).
Proof.
  intros Hv HS.
  set (k := v - 10).
  set (T := 2 ^ (v - 3)).
  assert (HT : 512 <= T) by (unfold T; change 512 with (2 ^ 9); apply pow_ge; lia).
  set (w := S * 2 ^ (v - 8)).
  assert (Ew : S * 2 ^ v = 256 * w).
  { unfold w. replace v with (8 + (v - 8)) at 1 by lia. rewrite Nat.pow_add_r. change (2 ^ 8) with 256. lia. }
  assert (Ew' : 256 * w = S * (8 * T)).
  { rewrite <- Ew. unfold T. replace v with (3 + (v - 3)) at 1 by lia. rewrite Nat.pow_add_r. reflexivity. }
  rewrite Ew. unfold VFe.
  change (phrow 1) with (phrow (17 mod 8)).
  apply (descent (fun x => phrow (x mod 8))); [|unfold off_end; destruct (Nat.eqb _ _); lia].
  intros x Hx. cbv beta.
  destruct (rowok_spec _ (phrow_ok (x mod 8))) as [Hmu [Hwn [Hvd [Hl1 Hl2]]]].
  assert (HL5 : 5 <= k + vlam (phrow (x mod 8)) - x).
  { apply off_end_L5; [lia|lia|]. intros E. rewrite (off_end_phase3 k x ltac:(lia) E). reflexivity. }
  assert (HP : 2 ^ (k + vlam (phrow (x mod 8)) - x - 1) <= T) by (unfold T; apply pow_ge; unfold k; lia).
  assert (Hm : 256 * w <= vmu (phrow (x mod 8)) * (256 * w)) by nia.
  assert (HV : vwn (phrow (x mod 8)) + 3 * 2 ^ (k + vlam (phrow (x mod 8)) - x - 1) + 256 <=
               vmu (phrow (x mod 8)) * (256 * w) + val_ (phrow (x mod 8)) * x + vwp (phrow (x mod 8))) by nia.
  assert (Hc : 4096 + 64 + vd (phrow (x mod 8)) <= 256 * w + x) by nia.
  apply vs_ph; assumption.
Qed.



(* ===================================================================== *)
(* 23. Lemma E (proof.md 6.1): C(b) at off 17 to the value form at 20.   *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Lemma bin_pow_odd i q : bin (2 ^ i * (2 * q + 1)) = repeat uD0 i ++ uD1 :: bin q.
Proof.
  induction i as [|i IH].
  - cbn [repeat app]. rewrite Nat.pow_0_r, Nat.mul_1_l. rewrite bin_pos by lia.
    rewrite dig_odd. f_equal. f_equal.
    replace (2 * q + 1) with (1 + q * 2) by lia. rewrite Nat.div_add by lia. reflexivity.
  - rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'. rewrite bin_pos by (pose proof (Nat.pow_nonzero 2 i); nia).
    rewrite <- Nat.mul_assoc, dig_even.
    replace (2 * (2 ^ i * (2 * q + 1)) / 2) with (2 ^ i * (2 * q + 1)).
    + rewrite IH. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (Nat.mul_comm 2 (2 ^ i * (2 * q + 1))), Nat.div_mul by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_D0s m w : shift (repeat uD0 m ++ w) =
  match shift w with Some w' => Some (repeat uD0 m ++ w') | None => None end.
Proof.
  induction m as [|m IH]; cbn [repeat app shift]; [destruct (shift w); reflexivity|].
  rewrite IH. destruct (shift w); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pj17 b : pj (32 * b + 17) = 48.
Proof.
  rewrite pj_mod. replace (32 * b + 17) with (1 + (4 * b + 2) * 8) by lia. rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_add. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma cs_step_conv Z D j Z' D1 j1 D2 j2 : cs_step Z D j Z' D1 j1 -> D1 = D2 -> j1 = j2 -> cs_step Z D j Z' D2 j2.
Proof. intros H -> ->. exact H. Qed.

Lemma E1 k q : 41 <= k ->
  let b := (2 * q + 1) * 2 ^ k - 2 in
  CS (Cst b) (repeat uD0 (k + 6) ++ uS1 :: bin q, 32 * b + 17, 32 * b + 18).
Proof.
  intros Hk b.
  set (o := 2 * q + 1) in *.
  set (P := 2 ^ (k - 3)).
  assert (HP : 2 ^ k = 8 * P) by (unfold P; replace k with (3 + (k - 3)) at 1 by lia; rewrite Nat.pow_add_r; reflexivity).
  assert (HP1 : 4096 <= P) by (unfold P; change 4096 with (2 ^ 12); apply pow_ge; lia).
  assert (Hb : b = 8 * o * P - 2) by (unfold b; rewrite HP; lia).
  unfold CS, Cst. cbn [fst snd].
  (* the zone is S1 :: bin V17 with V17 = 256 oP - 2 *)
  assert (Ez : [uS1; uD0; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1] ++ bin (S b) =
               [uS1; uD0; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1] ++ bin (o * P - 1)).
  { change ([uS1; uD0; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1] ++ bin (S b)) with (uS1 :: (digits 5 30 ++ bin (S b))).
    rewrite digits_app_bin by (cbn [Nat.pow Nat.mul Nat.add]; lia).
    rewrite (digits_bin_split 8) by (change (2 ^ 8) with 256; change (2 ^ 5) with 32; rewrite Hb; clear -HP1; nia).
    replace (30 + 2 ^ 5 * S b) with (254 + 2 ^ 8 * (o * P - 1)) by (rewrite Hb; change (2 ^ 5) with 32; change (2 ^ 8) with 256; clear -HP1; nia).
    rewrite digits_mod, div_mod_shift, Nat.div_small by (change (2 ^ 8) with 256; lia).
    reflexivity. }
  rewrite Ez.
  assert (Hx : xfeed 4000 4096 [uS1; uD0; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1] =
               Some (uP :: [uD1; uD0; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1], 16%N)) by reflexivity.
  apply xfeed_sound in Hx. change (N.to_nat 4096) with 4096%nat in Hx. change (N.to_nat 16) with 16%nat in Hx.
  set (X1 := [uD1; uD0; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1]).
  assert (Hc : 32 * b + 16 + pj (32 * b + 17) = 256 * (o * P)) by (rewrite pj17, Hb; nia).
  pose proof (XN_clean X1 (32 * b + 16 + pj (32 * b + 17) + 3 * 1 - 4096) eq_refl) as H2.
  replace (val X1 + (32 * b + 16 + pj (32 * b + 17) + 3 * 1 - 4096)) with (0 + 2 ^ ndig X1 * (o * P - 15)) in H2
    by (rewrite Hc; change (val X1) with 253; change (ndig X1) with 8; change (2 ^ 8) with 256; nia).
  rewrite fill_mod, div_mod_shift, Nat.Div0.div_0_l, Nat.add_0_l in H2.
  change (fill X1 0) with (repeat uD0 8) in H2.
  eapply cs_step_conv.
  { apply (cutstep [uS1; uD0; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1] (bin (o * P - 1)) 4096 16 1 X1
             (32 * b + 16 + pj (32 * b + 17)) (o * P - 15) (repeat uD0 8) (32 * b + 16) (32 * b + 17) _
             (bin (2 ^ (k - 2) * (2 * q + 1))) Hx eq_refl H2).
    - rewrite Hc. nia.
    - reflexivity.
    - replace (2 ^ (k - 2) * (2 * q + 1)) with (o * P - 1 + (16 + (o * P - 15))).
      + apply IncN_bin.
      + unfold o, P. replace (k - 2) with (S (k - 3)) by lia. rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'. fold P. nia.
    - rewrite shift_D0s, bin_pow_odd, shift_D0s. cbn [shift].
      rewrite app_assoc, <- repeat_app. replace (8 + (k - 2)) with (k + 6) by lia. reflexivity. }
  - lia.
  - lia.
Qed.

Definition s1w (q : nat) : list unt := if Nat.eqb q 0 then [uS1] else uP :: bin (2 * q - 1).

Lemma IncN_s1w q : IncN q (uS1 :: bin q) (s1w q).
Proof.
  unfold s1w. destruct q as [|q]; [constructor|]. cbn [Nat.eqb].
  econstructor; [constructor|]. apply IncN_P.
  replace (2 * S q - 1) with (S q + q) by lia. apply IncN_bin.
Qed.

Lemma digits_pow2 i : digits (S i) (2 ^ i) = repeat uD0 i ++ [uD1].
Proof.
  induction i as [|i IH]; [reflexivity|].
  change (digits (S (S i)) (2 ^ S i)) with (dig (2 ^ S i) :: digits (S i) (2 ^ S i / 2)).
  rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r', dig_even. rewrite Nat.mul_comm, Nat.div_mul by lia. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pj18 b : pj (32 * b + 18) = 48.
Proof.
  rewrite pj_mod. replace (32 * b + 18) with (2 + (4 * b + 2) * 8) by lia. rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_add. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma odd_half q P : 0 < P -> (2 * q + 1) * P / (2 * P) = q.
Proof.
  intros HP. symmetry. apply Nat.div_unique with P; lia.
Qed.

Lemma E2 k q : 41 <= k ->
  let b := (2 * q + 1) * 2 ^ k - 2 in
  CS (repeat uD0 (k + 6) ++ uS1 :: bin q, 32 * b + 17, 32 * b + 18)
     (uS1 :: repeat uD0 (k + 4) ++ uD1 :: s1w q, 32 * b + 17, 32 * b + 19).
Proof.
  intros Hk b.
  set (o := 2 * q + 1) in *.
  set (P := 2 ^ (k - 3)).
  assert (HP : 2 ^ k = 8 * P) by (unfold P; replace k with (3 + (k - 3)) at 1 by lia; rewrite Nat.pow_add_r; reflexivity).
  assert (HP1 : 4096 <= P) by (unfold P; change 4096 with (2 ^ 12); apply pow_ge; lia).
  assert (HP2 : 2 ^ (k - 2) = 2 * P) by (unfold P; replace (k - 2) with (S (k - 3)) by lia; apply Nat.pow_succ_r').
  assert (Hb : b = 8 * o * P - 2) by (unfold b; rewrite HP; lia).
  unfold CS. cbn [fst snd].
  replace (repeat uD0 (k + 6)) with (repeat uD0 8 ++ digits (k - 2) 0).
  2:{ replace (digits (k - 2) 0) with (repeat uD0 (k - 2)).
      - rewrite <- repeat_app. f_equal. lia.
      - generalize (k - 2). intros n. induction n as [|n IH]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [repeat digits]. rewrite IH. reflexivity. }
  rewrite <- app_assoc.
  assert (Hx : xfeed 4000 4096 (repeat uD0 8) = Some (repeat uD0 8, 16%N)) by reflexivity.
  apply xfeed_sound in Hx. change (N.to_nat 4096) with 4096%nat in Hx. change (N.to_nat 16) with 16%nat in Hx.
  assert (Hc : 32 * b + 17 + pj (32 * b + 18) = 256 * (o * P) + 1) by (rewrite pj18, Hb; nia).
  pose proof (XN_clean (repeat uD0 8) (32 * b + 17 + pj (32 * b + 18) + 3 * 0 - 4096) eq_refl) as H2.
  replace (val (repeat uD0 8) + (32 * b + 17 + pj (32 * b + 18) + 3 * 0 - 4096))
    with (1 + 2 ^ ndig (repeat uD0 8) * (o * P - 16)) in H2
    by (rewrite Hc; change (val (repeat uD0 8)) with O; change (ndig (repeat uD0 8)) with 8; change (2 ^ 8) with 256; nia).
  rewrite fill_mod, div_mod_shift, Nat.div_small in H2 by (change (ndig (repeat uD0 8)) with 8; cbn; lia).
  change (fill (repeat uD0 8) 1) with [uD1; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0] in H2.
  eapply cs_step_conv.
  { apply (cutstep (repeat uD0 8) (digits (k - 2) 0 ++ uS1 :: bin q) 4096 16 0 (repeat uD0 8)
             (32 * b + 17 + pj (32 * b + 18)) (0 + (o * P - 16)) [uD1; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0]
             (32 * b + 17) (32 * b + 18) _ (digits (k - 2) (0 + o * P) ++ s1w q) Hx eq_refl H2).
    - rewrite Hc. nia.
    - reflexivity.
    - replace (16 + (0 + (o * P - 16))) with (o * P) by nia.
      apply IncN_digits. rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_0_l, Nat.add_0_l, HP2. unfold o. rewrite odd_half by lia.
      apply IncN_s1w.
    - rewrite (shiftX_app [uD1; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0] [uS1; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0]) by reflexivity.
      f_equal.
      replace (0 + o * P) with (P + 2 ^ (k - 2) * q) by (rewrite HP2; unfold o; lia).
      rewrite digits_mod. replace (k - 2) with (S (k - 3)) by lia. unfold P. rewrite digits_pow2.
      cbn [app]. f_equal.
      replace (k + 4) with (7 + (k - 3)) by lia. rewrite repeat_app. cbn [repeat app].
      rewrite <- app_assoc. cbn [app]. reflexivity. }
  - lia.
  - lia.
Qed.

Lemma pj19 b : pj (32 * b + 19) = 47.
Proof.
  rewrite pj_mod. replace (32 * b + 19) with (3 + (4 * b + 2) * 8) by lia. rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_add. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma IncN_s1w_up q : IncN (2 * q + 1) (s1w q) (uP :: bin (4 * q)).
Proof.
  unfold s1w. destruct q as [|q]; cbn [Nat.eqb].
  - change (IncN 1 [uS1] [uP]). econstructor; [constructor|]. constructor.
  - apply IncN_P. replace (4 * S q) with (2 * S q - 1 + (2 * S q + 1)) by lia. apply IncN_bin.
Qed.

Lemma E3 k q : 41 <= k ->
  let b := (2 * q + 1) * 2 ^ k - 2 in
  CS (uS1 :: repeat uD0 (k + 4) ++ uD1 :: s1w q, 32 * b + 17, 32 * b + 19)
     ([uD0; uS1; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0] ++ digits (k - 3) (2 ^ (k - 4)) ++ uP :: bin (4 * q),
      32 * b + 18, 32 * b + 20).
Proof.
  intros Hk b.
  set (o := 2 * q + 1) in *.
  set (P := 2 ^ (k - 3)).
  assert (HP : 2 ^ k = 8 * P) by (unfold P; replace k with (3 + (k - 3)) at 1 by lia; rewrite Nat.pow_add_r; reflexivity).
  assert (HP1 : 4096 <= P) by (unfold P; change 4096 with (2 ^ 12); apply pow_ge; lia).
  assert (HP4 : P = 2 * 2 ^ (k - 4)) by (unfold P; replace (k - 3) with (S (k - 4)) by lia; apply Nat.pow_succ_r').
  assert (Hb : b = 8 * o * P - 2) by (unfold b; rewrite HP; lia).
  unfold CS. cbn [fst snd].
  replace (uS1 :: repeat uD0 (k + 4) ++ uD1 :: s1w q)
    with ((uS1 :: repeat uD0 8) ++ digits (k - 3) (2 ^ (k - 4)) ++ s1w q).
  2:{ replace (k - 3) with (S (k - 4)) by lia. rewrite digits_pow2.
      replace (k + 4) with (8 + (k - 4)) by lia. rewrite repeat_app.
      cbn [app]. rewrite <- !app_assoc. reflexivity. }
  assert (Hx : xfeed 4000 4096 (uS1 :: repeat uD0 8) =
               Some (uP :: [uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1], 15%N)) by reflexivity.
  apply xfeed_sound in Hx. change (N.to_nat 4096) with 4096%nat in Hx. change (N.to_nat 15) with 15%nat in Hx.
  set (X1 := [uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1]) in Hx.
  assert (Hc : 32 * b + 17 + pj (32 * b + 19) = 256 * (o * P)) by (rewrite pj19, Hb; nia).
  pose proof (XN_clean X1 (32 * b + 17 + pj (32 * b + 19) + 3 * 1 - 4096) eq_refl) as H2.
  replace (val X1 + (32 * b + 17 + pj (32 * b + 19) + 3 * 1 - 4096))
    with (2 + 2 ^ ndig X1 * (o * P - 15)) in H2
    by (rewrite Hc; change (val X1) with 255; change (ndig X1) with 8; change (2 ^ 8) with 256; nia).
  rewrite fill_mod, div_mod_shift, Nat.div_small in H2 by (change (ndig X1) with 8; cbn; lia).
  change (fill X1 2) with [uD0; uD1; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0] in H2.
  eapply cs_step_conv.
  { apply (cutstep (uS1 :: repeat uD0 8) (digits (k - 3) (2 ^ (k - 4)) ++ s1w q) 4096 15 1 X1
             (32 * b + 17 + pj (32 * b + 19)) (0 + (o * P - 15)) [uD0; uD1; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0]
             (32 * b + 17) (32 * b + 19) _ (digits (k - 3) (2 ^ (k - 4) + o * P) ++ uP :: bin (4 * q)) Hx eq_refl H2).
    - rewrite Hc. nia.
    - reflexivity.
    - replace (15 + (0 + (o * P - 15))) with (o * P) by nia.
      apply IncN_digits. fold P.
      replace ((2 ^ (k - 4) mod P + o * P) / P) with (2 * q + 1).
      + apply IncN_s1w_up.
      + rewrite Nat.mod_small by lia. apply Nat.div_unique with (2 ^ (k - 4)); unfold o; lia.
    - rewrite (shiftX_app [uD0; uD1; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0] [uD0; uS1; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0]) by reflexivity.
      f_equal. f_equal.
      replace (2 ^ (k - 4) + o * P) with (2 ^ (k - 4) + 2 ^ (k - 3) * o) by (unfold P; lia).
      rewrite digits_mod. reflexivity. }
  - lia.
  - lia.
Qed.

(* the off 20 form of Lemma E is the level-1 value form at off 20 *)
Lemma vfl_row20 m W : vfl [[]; [uS1]] (S (S m)) (4 * W) = uD0 :: uS1 :: uD0 :: vfl [] m W.
Proof.
  cbn [vfl hd tl app].
  replace (4 * W) with (2 * (2 * W)) by lia. rewrite dig_even.
  rewrite (Nat.mul_comm 2 (2 * W)), Nat.div_mul by lia. rewrite dig_even.
  rewrite (Nat.mul_comm 2 W), Nat.div_mul by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma E_id k q : 41 <= k ->
  let b := (2 * q + 1) * 2 ^ k - 2 in
  ([uD0; uS1; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0; uD0] ++ digits (k - 3) (2 ^ (k - 4)) ++ uP :: bin (4 * q),
   32 * b + 18, 32 * b + 20) = vfz (row1 20) k ((2 * q + 1) * 2 ^ (k + 5)) 20.
Proof.
  intros Hk b. unfold b.
  assert (E5 : 2 ^ (k + 5) = 32 * 2 ^ k) by (rewrite Nat.pow_add_r; change (2 ^ 5) with 32; lia).
  assert (E3' : 2 ^ (k + 3) = 8 * 2 ^ k) by (rewrite Nat.pow_add_r; change (2 ^ 3) with 8; lia).
  assert (E2' : 2 ^ (k + 2) = 4 * 2 ^ k) by (rewrite Nat.pow_add_r; change (2 ^ 2) with 4; lia).
  assert (E1' : 2 ^ (k + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ k) by (rewrite Nat.pow_add_r; change (2 ^ 1) with 2; lia).
  assert (HK : 1 <= 2 ^ k) by (pose proof (Nat.pow_nonzero 2 k); lia).
  unfold vfz. change (row1 20) with (mkV [[]; [uS1]] 24 1 0 0 0 2). cbn [vlam vmu val_ vwp vwn vd vh].
  replace (k + 24 - 20) with (S (S (k + 2))) by lia.
  replace (S (S (k + 2)) - 1) with (k + 3) by lia.
  match goal with |- context [vfl _ _ ?V] =>
    replace V with (4 * (2 ^ (k + 1) + 2 ^ (k + 2) * (4 * q))) by (rewrite E5, E3', E2', E1'; nia) end.
  rewrite vfl_row20, vfl_nil, digits_mod.
  replace ((2 ^ (k + 1) + 2 ^ (k + 2) * (4 * q)) / 2 ^ (k + 2)) with (4 * q)
    by (apply Nat.div_unique with (2 ^ (k + 1)); rewrite ?E2', ?E1'; lia).
  replace (k + 2) with (S (k + 1)) by lia. rewrite digits_pow2.
  replace (k - 3) with (S (k - 4)) by lia. rewrite digits_pow2.
  replace (k + 1) with (5 + (k - 4)) by lia. rewrite repeat_app.
  assert (HK6 : 64 <= 2 ^ k) by (change 64 with (2 ^ 6); apply pow_ge; lia).
  f_equal; [f_equal|]; try (cbn [app repeat]; rewrite <- ?app_assoc; reflexivity);
    rewrite E5; clear -HK6; nia.
Qed.

(* Lemma E: C(b) reaches the level-1 value form at off 20 *)
Theorem LemmaE k q : 41 <= k ->
  CSplus (Cst ((2 * q + 1) * 2 ^ k - 2)) (vfz (row1 20) k ((2 * q + 1) * 2 ^ (k + 5)) 20).
Proof.
  intros Hk.
  eapply CSpS; [apply (E1 k q Hk)|].
  eapply CSpS; [apply (E2 k q Hk)|].
  apply CSp1. rewrite <- (E_id k q Hk). apply (E3 k q Hk).
Qed.


(* ===================================================================== *)
(* 24. Lemma P (proof.md 6.5): the plant, off' 12 to off' 17.            *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Lemma pjg g i : pj (8 * g + i) = pj i.
Proof.
  rewrite pj_mod, (pj_mod i). f_equal. replace (8 * g + i) with (i + g * 8) by lia. apply Nat.Div0.mod_add.
Qed.

Lemma digits_0 n : digits n 0 = repeat uD0 n.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; [reflexivity|].
  change (digits (S n) 0) with (dig 0 :: digits n (0 / 2)). change (0 / 2) with O. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma digits_snoc m x : x < 2 ^ m -> digits (S m) x = digits m x ++ [uD0].
Proof.
  revert x; induction m as [|m IH]; intros x Hx.
  - cbn in Hx. assert (x = O) by lia. subst. reflexivity.
  - change (digits (S (S m)) x) with (dig x :: digits (S m) (x / 2)).
    rewrite IH.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r' in Hx. apply Nat.Div0.div_lt_upper_bound. lia.
Qed.

(* t carries on an r-digit block holding v leave v' and pass p *)
Lemma IncN_dig_q r v t p v' rest rest' : v' < 2 ^ r -> v + t = v' + 2 ^ r * p ->
  v < 2 ^ r -> IncN p rest rest' -> IncN t (digits r v ++ rest) (digits r v' ++ rest').
Proof.
  intros Hv' E Hv H.
  replace (digits r v') with (digits r (v + t)) by (rewrite E, digits_mod; reflexivity).
  apply IncN_digits. replace ((v mod 2 ^ r + t) / 2 ^ r) with p; [exact H|].
  rewrite Nat.mod_small by exact Hv. rewrite E. rewrite div_mod_shift, Nat.div_small by exact Hv'. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma XN_clean_q X t vx nd x p : allb cleanu X = true -> val X = vx -> ndig X = nd ->
  x < 2 ^ nd -> vx + t = x + 2 ^ nd * p -> XN t X p (fill X x).
Proof.
  intros Hc <- <- Hx E. pose proof (XN_clean X t Hc) as H.
  rewrite E, fill_mod, div_mod_shift, Nat.div_small in H by exact Hx. exact H.
Qed.

(* one closed-system step: a concrete low part X takes the first T0 carries
   (all drops), its clean rest X1 the remaining ones, Y the passed ones *)
Lemma pstep X Y T0 e1 A X1 vx nd x p X3 Y' D j D' j' :
  XN T0 X e1 (Ps A ++ X1) -> dhead X1 = true -> allb cleanu X1 = true -> val X1 = vx -> ndig X1 = nd ->
  x < 2 ^ nd -> vx + (D + pj j + 3 * A - T0) = x + 2 ^ nd * p -> T0 <= D + pj j ->
  IncN (e1 + p) Y Y' -> shiftX (fill X1 x) = Some X3 -> D' = D + A -> j' = S j ->
  CS (X ++ Y, D, j) (X3 ++ Y', D', j').
Proof.
  intros H1 Hd Hc Ev En Hx E HT HY Hs -> ->. unfold CS; cbn [fst snd].
  eapply (cutstep X Y T0 e1 A X1 (D + pj j) p (fill X1 x) D j (X3 ++ Y') Y' H1 Hd).
  - eapply XN_clean_q; eauto.
  - exact HT.
  - reflexivity.
  - exact HY.
  - apply shiftX_app. exact Hs.
Qed.

(* a step without drops on a zone with a digit at the bottom *)
Lemma cs_nodrop Z D j Y Z' : dhead Z = true -> IncN (D + pj j) Z Y -> shift Y = Some Z' ->
  CS (Z, D, j) (Z', D, S j).
Proof.
  intros Hd HI Hs. unfold CS; cbn [fst snd].
  exists (D + pj j), O, Y.
  split; [exact HI|]. split; [apply dhead_notP; eapply IncN_dhead; eauto|]. split; [lia|]. split.
  - intros m' A' Y' Hm Hi HN. destruct A' as [|A'].
    + lia.
    + exfalso. pose proof (IncN_dhead _ _ _ Hd Hi) as H. cbn in H. discriminate.
  - split; [exact Hs|split; lia].
Qed.

Lemma Inc_W3 w w3 w4 : IncN 3 w w3 -> shift w3 = Some w4 -> Inc (uW :: w) (uP :: w4).
Proof.
  intros H Hs. destruct (IncN_3_inv _ _ H) as [a [b [H1 [H2 H3]]]].
  eapply Inc_W; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma s1w_pos Q : 1 <= Q -> s1w Q = uP :: bin (2 * Q - 1).
Proof. intros HQ. unfold s1w. destruct Q; [lia|reflexivity]. Qed.

Definition gP (n Q : nat) : nat := (2 * Q + 1) * 2 ^ n - 8.

Lemma HW n : 7 <= n -> 128 <= 2 ^ n.
Proof. intros Hn. change 128 with (2 ^ 7). apply pow_ge. lia. Qed.

Lemma Hg n Q : 7 <= n -> 8 * gP n Q + 64 = 8 * ((2 * Q + 1) * 2 ^ n).
Proof. intros Hn. pose proof (HW n Hn). unfold gP. nia. Qed.

Lemma vfl_S1 m V : 1 <= m -> vfl [[uS1]] m V = uS1 :: digits m V ++ uP :: bin (V / 2 ^ m).
Proof.
  intros Hm. destruct m as [|m]; [lia|].
  change (vfl [[uS1]] (S m) V) with (uS1 :: vfl [] (S m) V). f_equal. apply vfl_nil.
Qed.

Lemma digits_snoc' m x : 1 <= m -> x < 2 ^ (m - 1) -> digits m x = digits (m - 1) x ++ [uD0].
Proof. intros Hm Hx. destruct m as [|m]; [lia|]. replace (S m - 1) with m in * by lia. apply digits_snoc. exact Hx. Qed.

Lemma P12 n Q : 7 <= n -> 1 <= Q ->
  CS ([uS1; uP; uP; uD0; uD0; uD0; uP] ++ digits n (2 ^ n - 3) ++ bin (2 * Q), 8 * gP n Q + 8, 8 * gP n Q + 12)
     ([uD0; uD0; uD0; uSP] ++ digits n (2 ^ n - 3) ++ bin (4 * Q + 1), 8 * gP n Q + 11, 8 * gP n Q + 13).
Proof.
  intros Hn HQ. pose proof (HW n Hn) as HW'. pose proof (Hg n Q Hn) as Hg'. set (W := 2 ^ n) in *.
  assert (Hx : xfeed 4000 8 [uS1; uP; uP; uD0; uD0; uD0; uP] =
               Some (Ps 3 ++ [uD1; uD1; uD1; uP], 0%N)) by reflexivity.
  apply xfeed_sound in Hx. change (N.to_nat 8) with 8%nat in Hx. change (N.to_nat 0) with O in Hx.
  eapply (pstep _ _ 8 0 3 [uD1; uD1; uD1; uP] 7 3 0 ((2 * Q + 1) * W)); [exact Hx|reflexivity|reflexivity|reflexivity|reflexivity| | | | | |lia|lia].
  - cbn. lia.
  - rewrite pjg. change (pj 12) with 48. change (2 ^ 3) with 8. lia.
  - rewrite pjg. change (pj 12) with 48. lia.
  - rewrite Nat.add_0_l. apply (IncN_dig_q n (W - 3) _ (2 * Q + 1) (W - 3)); [fold W; lia|fold W; nia|fold W; lia|].
    replace (4 * Q + 1) with (2 * Q + (2 * Q + 1)) by lia. apply IncN_bin.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma P13 n Q : 7 <= n -> 1 <= Q ->
  CS ([uD0; uD0; uD0; uSP] ++ digits n (2 ^ n - 3) ++ bin (4 * Q + 1), 8 * gP n Q + 11, 8 * gP n Q + 13)
     ([uD0; uS1; uD0; uP] ++ digits n (2 ^ n - 3) ++ uD0 :: s1w Q, 8 * gP n Q + 11, 8 * gP n Q + 14).
Proof.
  intros Hn HQ. pose proof (HW n Hn) as HW'. pose proof (Hg n Q Hn) as Hg'. set (W := 2 ^ n) in *.
  set (R := digits n (W - 3) ++ bin (4 * Q + 1)).
  set (R4 := digits n 0 ++ digits 1 0 ++ uS1 :: bin Q).
  assert (HR : Inc (uW :: R) (uP :: R4)).
  { apply (Inc_W3 R (digits n 0 ++ bin (4 * Q + 2))).
    - unfold R. apply (IncN_dig_q n (W - 3) 3 1 0); [fold W; lia|fold W; lia|fold W; lia|].
      replace (4 * Q + 2) with (4 * Q + 1 + 1) by lia. apply IncN_bin.
    - replace (4 * Q + 2) with (2 ^ 1 * (2 * Q + 1)) by (cbn; lia). rewrite bin_pow_odd, digits_0.
      rewrite shift_D0s. cbn [repeat app shift]. unfold R4. rewrite digits_0. reflexivity. }
  replace (8 * gP n Q + 14) with (S (8 * gP n Q + 13)) by lia.
  apply (cs_nodrop _ _ _ ([uD0; uD1; uD0; uP] ++ digits n (W - 3) ++ digits 1 0 ++ s1w Q)).
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite pjg. change (pj 13) with 47.
    replace (8 * gP n Q + 11 + 47) with (8 + (8 + ((8 * ((2 * Q + 1) * W) - 22)))) by lia.
    eapply IncN_add.
    { change ([uD0; uD0; uD0; uSP] ++ R) with (digits 3 0 ++ uSP :: R).
      apply (IncN_dig_q 3 0 8 1 0 _ (uW :: R)); [cbn; lia|cbn; lia|cbn; lia|]. apply IncN_1. constructor. }
    eapply IncN_add.
    { apply (IncN_dig_q 3 0 8 1 0 _ (uP :: R4)); [cbn; lia|cbn; lia|cbn; lia|]. apply IncN_1. exact HR. }
    change ([uD0; uD1; uD0; uP] ++ digits n (W - 3) ++ digits 1 0 ++ s1w Q)
      with (digits 3 2 ++ uP :: digits n (W - 3) ++ digits 1 0 ++ s1w Q).
    apply (IncN_dig_q 3 0 _ ((2 * Q + 1) * W - 3) 2); [cbn; lia|change (2 ^ 3) with 8; nia|cbn; lia|].
    apply IncN_P. unfold R4.
    apply (IncN_dig_q n 0 _ (2 * Q) (W - 3)); [fold W; lia|fold W; nia|fold W; lia|].
    apply (IncN_dig_q 1 0 _ Q 0); [cbn; lia|cbn; lia|cbn; lia|]. apply IncN_s1w.
  - apply shiftX_app. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma P14 n Q : 7 <= n -> 1 <= Q ->
  CS ([uD0; uS1; uD0; uP] ++ digits n (2 ^ n - 3) ++ uD0 :: s1w Q, 8 * gP n Q + 11, 8 * gP n Q + 14)
     ([uS1; uP; uD0; uP] ++ digits n (2 ^ n - 5) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (4 * Q), 8 * gP n Q + 11, 8 * gP n Q + 15).
Proof.
  intros Hn HQ. pose proof (HW n Hn) as HW'. pose proof (Hg n Q Hn) as Hg'. set (W := 2 ^ n) in *.
  assert (Hx : xfeed 4000 2 [uD0; uS1; uD0] = Some (Ps 0 ++ [uD0; uP; uD0], 0%N)) by reflexivity.
  apply xfeed_sound in Hx. change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat in Hx. change (N.to_nat 0) with O in Hx.
  change ([uD0; uS1; uD0; uP] ++ digits n (W - 3) ++ uD0 :: s1w Q)
    with ([uD0; uS1; uD0] ++ uP :: digits n (W - 3) ++ uD0 :: s1w Q).
  change ([uS1; uP; uD0; uP] ++ digits n (W - 5) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (4 * Q))
    with ([uS1; uP; uD0] ++ uP :: digits n (W - 5) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (4 * Q)).
  eapply (pstep _ _ 2 0 0 [uD0; uP; uD0] 0 2 1 (2 * (2 * Q + 1) * W - 2)); [exact Hx|reflexivity|reflexivity|reflexivity|reflexivity| | | | | |lia|lia].
  - cbn. lia.
  - rewrite pjg. change (pj 14) with 48. change (2 ^ 2) with 4. lia.
  - rewrite pjg. change (pj 14) with 48. lia.
  - rewrite Nat.add_0_l. apply IncN_P. rewrite s1w_pos by exact HQ.
    apply (IncN_dig_q n (W - 3) _ (2 * (2 * Q + 1)) (W - 5)); [fold W; lia|fold W; nia|fold W; lia|].
    change (uD0 :: uP :: bin (2 * Q - 1)) with (digits 1 0 ++ uP :: bin (2 * Q - 1)).
    change (uD0 :: uP :: bin (4 * Q)) with (digits 1 0 ++ uP :: bin (4 * Q)).
    apply (IncN_dig_q 1 0 _ (2 * Q + 1) 0); [cbn; lia|cbn; lia|cbn; lia|].
    apply IncN_P. replace (4 * Q) with (2 * Q - 1 + (2 * Q + 1)) by lia. apply IncN_bin.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma P15 n Q : 7 <= n -> 1 <= Q ->
  CS ([uS1; uP; uD0; uP] ++ digits n (2 ^ n - 5) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (4 * Q), 8 * gP n Q + 11, 8 * gP n Q + 15)
     ([uS1; uP] ++ digits n (2 ^ n - 6) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (8 * Q + 2), 8 * gP n Q + 13, 8 * gP n Q + 16).
Proof.
  intros Hn HQ. pose proof (HW n Hn) as HW'. pose proof (Hg n Q Hn) as Hg'. set (W := 2 ^ n) in *.
  assert (Hx : xfeed 4000 1 [uS1; uP; uD0] = Some (Ps 2 ++ [uD0], 0%N)) by reflexivity.
  apply xfeed_sound in Hx. change (N.to_nat 1) with 1%nat in Hx. change (N.to_nat 0) with O in Hx.
  change ([uS1; uP; uD0; uP] ++ digits n (W - 5) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (4 * Q))
    with ([uS1; uP; uD0] ++ uP :: digits n (W - 5) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (4 * Q)).
  change ([uS1; uP] ++ digits n (W - 6) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (8 * Q + 2))
    with ([uS1] ++ uP :: digits n (W - 6) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (8 * Q + 2)).
  eapply (pstep _ _ 1 0 2 [uD0] 0 1 1 (4 * (2 * Q + 1) * W - 1)); [exact Hx|reflexivity|reflexivity|reflexivity|reflexivity| | | | | |lia|lia].
  - cbn. lia.
  - rewrite pjg. change (pj 15) with 47. change (2 ^ 1) with 2. lia.
  - rewrite pjg. change (pj 15) with 47. lia.
  - rewrite Nat.add_0_l. apply IncN_P.
    apply (IncN_dig_q n (W - 5) _ (4 * (2 * Q + 1)) (W - 6)); [fold W; lia|fold W; nia|fold W; lia|].
    change (uD0 :: uP :: bin (4 * Q)) with (digits 1 0 ++ uP :: bin (4 * Q)).
    change (uD0 :: uP :: bin (8 * Q + 2)) with (digits 1 0 ++ uP :: bin (8 * Q + 2)).
    apply (IncN_dig_q 1 0 _ (2 * (2 * Q + 1)) 0); [cbn; lia|cbn; lia|cbn; lia|].
    apply IncN_P. replace (8 * Q + 2) with (4 * Q + 2 * (2 * Q + 1)) by lia. apply IncN_bin.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma P16 n Q : 7 <= n -> 1 <= Q ->
  CS ([uS1; uP] ++ digits n (2 ^ n - 6) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (8 * Q + 2), 8 * gP n Q + 13, 8 * gP n Q + 16)
     ([uS1] ++ digits (n - 1) (2 ^ (n - 1) - 3) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (16 * Q + 6), 8 * gP n Q + 15, 8 * gP n Q + 17).
Proof.
  intros Hn HQ. pose proof (HW n Hn) as HW'. pose proof (Hg n Q Hn) as Hg'. set (W := 2 ^ n) in *.
  set (H := 2 ^ (n - 1)).
  assert (EH : W = 2 * H) by (unfold W, H; replace n with (S (n - 1)) at 1 by lia; apply Nat.pow_succ_r').
  assert (Ed : digits n (W - 6) = uD0 :: digits (n - 1) (H - 3)).
  { replace n with (S (n - 1)) at 1 by lia. change (digits (S (n - 1)) (W - 6)) with (dig (W - 6) :: digits (n - 1) ((W - 6) / 2)).
    replace (W - 6) with (2 * (H - 3)) by lia. rewrite dig_even.
    rewrite (Nat.mul_comm 2 (H - 3)), Nat.div_mul by lia. reflexivity. }
  rewrite Ed.
  assert (Hx : xfeed 4000 1 [uS1; uP; uD0] = Some (Ps 2 ++ [uD0], 0%N)) by reflexivity.
  apply xfeed_sound in Hx. change (N.to_nat 1) with 1%nat in Hx. change (N.to_nat 0) with O in Hx.
  change ([uS1; uP] ++ (uD0 :: digits (n - 1) (H - 3)) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (8 * Q + 2))
    with ([uS1; uP; uD0] ++ digits (n - 1) (H - 3) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (8 * Q + 2)).
  eapply (pstep _ _ 1 0 2 [uD0] 0 1 1 (4 * (2 * Q + 1) * W)); [exact Hx|reflexivity|reflexivity|reflexivity|reflexivity| | | | | |lia|lia].
  - cbn. lia.
  - rewrite pjg. change (pj 16) with 47. change (2 ^ 1) with 2. lia.
  - rewrite pjg. change (pj 16) with 47. lia.
  - rewrite Nat.add_0_l.
    assert (HH : 64 <= H) by lia.
    apply (IncN_dig_q (n - 1) (H - 3) _ (8 * (2 * Q + 1)) (H - 3)); [fold H; lia|fold H; nia|fold H; lia|].
    change (uD0 :: uP :: bin (8 * Q + 2)) with (digits 1 0 ++ uP :: bin (8 * Q + 2)).
    change (uD0 :: uP :: bin (16 * Q + 6)) with (digits 1 0 ++ uP :: bin (16 * Q + 6)).
    apply (IncN_dig_q 1 0 _ (4 * (2 * Q + 1)) 0); [cbn; lia|cbn; lia|cbn; lia|].
    apply IncN_P. replace (16 * Q + 6) with (8 * Q + 2 + 4 * (2 * Q + 1)) by lia. apply IncN_bin.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Theorem LemmaP n Q : 7 <= n -> 1 <= Q ->
  CSplus ([uS1; uP; uP; uD0; uD0; uD0; uP] ++ digits n (2 ^ n - 3) ++ bin (2 * Q), 8 * gP n Q + 8, 8 * gP n Q + 12)
         ([uS1] ++ digits (n - 1) (2 ^ (n - 1) - 3) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (16 * Q + 6), 8 * gP n Q + 15, 8 * gP n Q + 17).
Proof.
  intros Hn HQ.
  eapply CSpS; [apply P12; auto|]. eapply CSpS; [apply P13; auto|]. eapply CSpS; [apply P14; auto|].
  eapply CSpS; [apply P15; auto|]. apply CSp1. apply P16; auto.
Qed.

(* the plant end is the level-2 value form at off' 17 *)
Lemma P_id n Q : 7 <= n -> 1 <= Q ->
  ([uS1] ++ digits (n - 1) (2 ^ (n - 1) - 3) ++ uD0 :: uP :: bin (16 * Q + 6), 8 * gP n Q + 15, 8 * gP n Q + 17)
  = vfz (phrow 1) (n - 7) ((2 * Q + 1) * 2 ^ (n + 3)) 17.
Proof.
  intros Hn HQ. pose proof (HW n Hn) as HW'. pose proof (Hg n Q Hn) as Hg'.
  assert (EH : 2 ^ n = 2 * 2 ^ (n - 1)) by (replace n with (S (n - 1)) at 1 by lia; apply Nat.pow_succ_r').
  assert (E3 : 2 ^ (n + 3) = 8 * 2 ^ n) by (rewrite Nat.pow_add_r; change (2 ^ 3) with 8; lia).
  assert (HH : 64 <= 2 ^ (n - 1)) by lia.
  unfold vfz. change (phrow 1) with (mkV [[uS1]] 24 1 1 0 20 2). cbn [vlam vmu val_ vwp vwn vd vh].
  replace (n - 7 + 24 - 17) with n by lia.
  match goal with |- context [vfl _ _ ?V] =>
    replace V with ((2 ^ (n - 1) - 3) + 2 ^ n * (16 * Q + 6)) by (rewrite E3, EH; rewrite EH in Hg'; nia) end.
  rewrite vfl_S1 by lia. rewrite digits_mod. rewrite (digits_snoc' n) by lia.
  replace ((2 ^ (n - 1) - 3 + 2 ^ n * (16 * Q + 6)) / 2 ^ n) with (16 * Q + 6)
    by (apply Nat.div_unique with (2 ^ (n - 1) - 3); lia).
  f_equal; [f_equal|]; try (cbn [app]; rewrite <- ?app_assoc; reflexivity); rewrite E3; lia.
Qed.

(* the start of the plant is the value form at off_end(K) when 8 | K + 9 *)
Lemma vfl_plant y : vfl [[uS1; uP; uP]] 3 (8 * y) = [uS1; uP; uP; uD0; uD0; uD0; uP] ++ bin y.
Proof.
  cbn [vfl hd tl app].
  replace (8 * y) with (2 * (4 * y)) by lia. rewrite dig_even.
  rewrite (Nat.mul_comm 2 (4 * y)), Nat.div_mul by lia.
  replace (4 * y) with (2 * (2 * y)) by lia. rewrite dig_even.
  rewrite (Nat.mul_comm 2 (2 * y)), Nat.div_mul by lia. rewrite dig_even.
  rewrite (Nat.mul_comm 2 y), Nat.div_mul by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.



Lemma VFe_plant K Om n Q : 7 <= n -> 1 <= Q -> (K + 9) mod 8 = O -> 41 <= K ->
  Om + K + 9 = (2 * Q + 1) * 2 ^ (n + 3) ->
  VFe K Om = ([uS1; uP; uP; uD0; uD0; uD0; uP] ++ digits n (2 ^ n - 3) ++ bin (2 * Q),
              8 * gP n Q + 8, 8 * gP n Q + 12).
Proof.
  intros Hn HQ H8 HK HM.
  assert (HW : 128 <= 2 ^ n) by (change 128 with (2 ^ 7); apply pow_ge; lia).
  assert (E3 : 2 ^ (n + 3) = 8 * 2 ^ n) by (rewrite Nat.pow_add_r; change (2 ^ 3) with 8; lia).
  assert (Eo : off_end K = K + 21).
